L'internationale de la surveillance


En parcourant les journaux ce 13 août, on apprend en réalité que les ministères de l'Intérieur et les services de renseignement s'activaient en coulisse des deux côtés des Alpes bien en amont de la manifestation annoncée. La coopération franco-italienne s'est mise en place à partir du moment où les flics italiens ont alerté les services français de la forte probabilité que de nombreuses personnes traversent la frontières dans le but de participer à la manifestation. On apprend même plus précisément dans le Monde qu'un Français que les renseignements italiens ont placé dans leurs petites fiches comme proche des Soulèvements de la terre a été signalé par les Italiens aux Français qui ont mis en place une enquête administrative et une filature sur cette personne et son entourage. Sur la simple mention d'aller-retours à la frontière.


Petit à petit, le filet de la surveillance s'élargit alors même qu'on ne comprend pas bien quel cadre légal permet cette surveillance, outre la suspicion d'un déplacement prochain vers l'Italie. Ainsi, un groupe d'une dizaine de personnes est activement surveillé par les services de renseignement de la Préfecture de Paris qui les prend en photo et les filme abondamment, notamment pour tenter de déclencher une interpellation préventive. Les flics prétendent avec leurs images que le groupe se serait entraîné à lancer "ce qui ressemble à des engins explosifs" dans les anciens tunnels ferroviaires de la petite couronnne. Assez pour que les services de renseignements de Paris soient effrayés par ces "entraînements" qui constituerait selon eux la preuve de la préparation d'une action violente contre la ligne Lyon-Turin.


«

 

On a été traités comme un groupe terroriste

 

»


Le 23 juillet, soit donc deux jours avant la manifestation au départ de Venaus, huit personnes sont interpellées préventivement sur simples éléments de notes de surveillance de l'enquête administrative. Des persquisitions sont réalisées chez chacun·es des interpelé·es, leurs matériel informatique ainsi que leurs moyens de communication saisis. Le 27 juillet, les huit interpelé·es sont mis en examen pour pour “association de malfaiteurs, détention et transport de produits incendiaires en bande organisée”. Le parquet de Paris leur reproche notamment la détention de mortiers d'artifices, mais également de téléphones dédiés à la mobilisation et au déplacement en Italie.


Hier, mercredi 12 août, ils et elles ont toustes été relâchés après un passage à la chambre d'instruction de Paris, malgré l'insistance du parquet de les placer en détention provisoire, relatée par les journalistes présent·es. Iels sont placé·es sous contrôle judiciaire en attendant leur procès.


La lutte NoTAV face à la répression, une histoire ancienne


Comme Notre Dame des Landes ou encore Bure, la lutte No

TAV

, de par sa pérennité et son intensité, a été et est encore un laboratoire de la répression policière comme juridique, par les Etats italien et français. Elle a fait l'objet de violentes opérations policières — pour n'en citer qu'une, l'évacuation de l'occupation en 2011, pour laquelle l'État italien déploie 2 500 policiers et soldats et lance 4 000 grenades ­lacrymogènes sur les manifestantEs, provoque des centaines de blessé·es et une cinquantaine d'arrestations. À la suite de ces nombreuses actions de sabotage, ce territoire est déclaré «

 

zone militaire surveillée

 

» par la police et l'armée.

author: Amira El-Fekki
title: ‘Privacy chaos’: From fraudulent SIM registration to biometric data collection?
content:
A university student was sentenced last week to 25 years in prison, after a SIM card registered in his name was used in a drug-trafficking operation. He and his family have insisted that he never used the SIM card and had not even bought the card in the first place.


His case prompted many to check their own digital profiles and discover that dozens of phone numbers had been registered to their names without their knowledge.


In a wave of anger and concern about digital security, personal data security has become the topic of the hour as the scale of fraudulent phone line registration becomes clear.


The issue has been described as stemming from inadequate checks by mobile operators, who are supposed to demand passport or ID verification in person before allowing customers to establish a mobile phone number.


But permitting phone lines to be issued to customers showing digital copies of passports  leaves the door wide open to fraud, with commentators pointing to dozens of photographed IDs floating around digital platforms and messaging apps ripe for the taking.


The National Telecom Regulatory Authority has referred Egypt’s four mobile operators — Vodafone, Orange, e& and WE — to the Public Prosecution.


The NTRA has also proposed the introduction of biometric identity verification for the registration of new mobile network subscribers.


But why did the NTRA not detect or address the problem before it escalated? How are mobile companies held accountable for the data they collect and retain? 


And while steps have been taken to hold the companies legally responsible, is it enough to get to the root of the problem and ensure that biometric data handed to the NTRA will be handled securely?


The proposed biometric verification comes as Egypt’s personal data protection framework continues to face questions. Unlike data that can be changed, such as passwords, biometric data, such as facial scans, finger prints or eye scans, is permanently linked to the individual, and there is no going back if it is leaked. 


Its use across different services and platforms could also allow for the collection and collation of data belonging to the same person, to build an online data profile of them.


Mada Masr spoke to Mohamed al-Taher, the cofounder of and researcher with Masaar, an organization dedicated to digital rights and freedoms in Egypt, as well as Hassan al-Azhary, a lawyer and researcher with the organization, to unpack the implications of the NTRA’s decision. 


Azhary describes to Mada Masr the NTRA’s regulatory responsibilities and the legal ramifications of citizens discovering mobile lines registered in their names without their knowledge. He also talks us through data protection in Egypt and the loopholes in the regulatory framework and its enforcement. 


And Taher, meanwhile, points to the government’s inclination to begin using biometric data. 


Together, the pair express doubt as to whether biometric identity verification will solve the issue of fraudulent SIM card registration. Instead, they say, it could merely add another dimension to what they dub Egypt’s “privacy chaos.”


The interviews have been lightly edited for clarity.


Mada Masr:

The national regulator, the NTRA, said on Monday that it had referred Egypt’s four mobile operators to the Public Prosecution. Can we expect the referral to bring about better regulation and security in the handling of mobile data?


Hassan al-Azhary:

 The statement acknowledges that the incident is real, meaning there is a problem that concerns citizens complaining that lines have been registered in their names when they didn’t buy those lines.


SIM card distributors used to sell what were called “old” lines: there was this broad, vague and unclear discussion around the issue. This is the first clear and official acknowledgment that there is a problem.


Referring the matter to the Public Prosecution is important because it opens the door more broadly for affected citizens to start bringing lawsuits against the companies, depending on the harm they suffered. Some may seek compensation because they suffered direct harm. Others may seek compensation because they fear that they could be harmed, while some may seek to terminate their contracts. It depends on the extent of the harm each person has suffered.


The third point is that this referral shifts the matter from a question of administrative accountability to one of criminal accountability.

author: Unknown
title: ‘Gülistan Doku dosyasında karanlık ilişki ağı ortaya çıktı’
content:
Gülistan Doku’nun kaybolmasının üzerinden altı yıl geçerken soruşturma kapsamında 2026 yılının nisan ayından bu yana peş peşe operasyonlar gerçekleştirildi. Dönemin Tunceli Valisi Tuncay Sonel’in de tutuklandığı soruşturmada emniyet, sağlık ve siber faaliyetler üzerinden yürütüldüğü öne sürülen örtbas ağına ilişkin çok sayıda kişi hakkında işlem yapıldı. Doku ailesinin avukatı Ali Çimen, soruşturmanın altı yıl boyunca sistematik bir örtbas faaliyetiyle sürüncemede bırakıldığını belirterek, son operasyonlarla birlikte “karanlık bir ilişki ağının” ortaya çıktığını söylüyor. Çimen ile soruşturmada gelinen aşamaya dair konuştuk.

Doku soruşturmasında neler olmuştu?

Pek çok operasyon gerçekleşti nisan ayından beri. Çok sayıda kişi gözaltına alındı bunlar arasında sağlıkçılar, polisler, bilişim uzmanları, dalgıçlar, korucular dahil olmak üzere pek çok şüpheli vardı. Biraz açabilir misiniz? Siz 108 kişilik bir şüpheli listesi verdiğinizi belirttiniz yaptığınız açıklamalarda. Bu 108 kişi soruşturma açısından nereye oturuyorlar?

Gülistan Doku soruşturması dosyası 6 Ocak 2020 tarihinde ailenin şikayeti üzerinde başlatıldı. Ağustos 2024'e kadar geçen süreyi biz, sistematik olarak gerçekleşmiş bir örtbas faaliyeti olarak değerlendirdik. Bu örtbas faaliyeti; delillerin karartılması, yeni deliller uydurulmak suretiyle dosyanın intihara yönlendirilmesinin yanı sıra, dosyaya sahip çıkan kişilere yönelik olarak da sindirme şeklinde gerçekleşti. Gülistan Doku'nun ailesi ve Dersim Kadın Platformu öncülüğünde gelişen kadın direnişi, dosyanın kapatılmasına engel oldu. Yürüyüşler gerçekleştirildi, sosyal medyada yoğun bir şekilde “Gülistan Doku nerede?” diye paylaşımlar yapıldı ve o sırada baş şüphelimiz konumunda olan Zaynal Abarakov dönemin valisi tarafından yurt dışına çıkarılmıştı. BU sırada dönemin İl Emniyet Müdürü ve İl Asayiş Şube Müdürü tarafından kendisine soruşturulmama güvencesi verildiği iddia ediliyor. Dosyanın tek şüphelisi yurt dışındaydı ve elimizde başka kimse yoktu. Dersim Kadın Platformunun direnişi sayesinde Zaynal'ı yurt dışından getirmek zorunda kaldılar ve bize bir hedef verdiler. Biz de o anki delil durumuna göre Zaynal ve ailesine yüklendik. Onlar da son yapılan operasyonla aslında neler olduğunu bize açıkladılar.

2024 yılının Ağustos ayında başsavcı değişikliği ile beraber dosyada etkili bir soruşturma yapılmaya başlandı. Aslında biz 24 Ocak 2024’te dosyaya dönemin valisi Tuncay Sonel'in şüpheli olarak eklenmesine yönelik yazılı talebimizi yapmıştık. Bununla beraber dosyaya gizlilik gelmişti. “Ceset olmazsa cinayet olmaz” şeklinde gereksiz bir tartışma yürütüldü, ta ki 2026 yılı Nisan ayına kadar. 14 Nisan’da ilk dalga operasyon yapıldı. Bu operasyonda 17 kişi gözaltına alındı, 12 tutuklama gerçekleşti. Dosyadaki delil durumuna göre dönemin valisinin de suça karıştığı anlaşıldığı için, onun yargılama usulü, bağlı bulunduğu yere en yakın Bölge Adliye Mahkemesinin bağlı bulunduğu Başsavcılık tarafından yürütüldü. Erzurum'da 17 Nisan’da dönemin valisi Tuncay Sonel’in gözaltı işlemleri yapıldı. O da tutuklandı ve soruşturmanın ilk dalgası o şekilde sonuçlandı. 21 Temmuz’da ikinci dalga operasyon yapıldı. Bu operasyonda dönemin valisinin eşi ve siber çetenin Ankara ayağı gözaltına alındı. Aynı zamanda Erzurum Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı örtbasın sağlık ayağına yönelik bir operasyon yaptı, 10 kişi gözaltına alındı. Gözaltına alınanlardan sadece üç kişi hakkında aslında talepte bulunmuştuk. Bir mağduriyetin olmasına da izin veremeyiz. Sadece bir evrağı götüren memurun gözaltına alınmasını doğru bulmayız. Çünkü sağlık yönüne ilişkin örtbasın, Akgün firmasının yazılı cevabına göre SİSO firması ile bağlantılı olduğu anlaşılıyor. Dolayısıyla o yönde bir operasyon yapılması gerekiyordu. Onu da belirttik biz.

23 Temmuz’da 5 kişi hakkında işlem yapıldı. Bu 5 kişiden 3’ü zaten tutuluydu: Şükrü Eroğlu, Gökhan Ertok ve Tuncay Sonel. Diğer iki kişi, Ankara'daki siber çetenin iddia edilen üyeleriydi ve bunlardan biri daha tutuklandı. Operasyonun konusu, Tuncay Sonel’in cep telefonunda ele geçirilen ve soruşturmanın konusuyla ilgili olmayan buluntu delillerdi. Tuncay Sonel’in Ordu Valisi olduğu dönemde kendisine eleştiri tweeti atan bir kişiyi Ankara’da faaliyet gösteren siber çete elemanlarına bildirerek, o kişinin sahte bir operasyonla derdest edilip işkence edilmesi ve teşhir edilmesi sağlandı. Ayrıca Tuncay Sonel ile çekilmiş fotoğraflarının gönderilmesi ve gittikleri eve böcek yerleştirilmesi gibi eylemler gerçekleştirildi …

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: State surveillance in schools angers teachers
content:
Photo from the Philippine Information Agency.

“Sara Duterte must be held accountable for misusing OVP and DepEd funds for operations that have nothing to do with improving the quality of education in the country.”

CAGAYAN DE ORO — This week’s impeachment trial hearing exposed Vice President Sara Duterte’s failure to properly liquidate a substantial amount from the more than P600-million confidential and intelligence funds (CIFs) in the Office of the Vice President (OVP) and the Department of Education (DepEd).

Unspecified confidential activities in their approved Physical and Financial Plans, inconsistent dates and undated acknowledgement receipts, no documentary evidence for payments, and not allowable expenditures were among the findings of witness Roderick Wamil, former state auditor of the Commission on Audit (COA)-Intelligence and Confidential Funds Audit Unit (ICFAU), when he audited the CIFs in both agencies. He stressed that these were not compliant to Joint Circular No. 2015-01 or the guidelines on the entitlement, release, use, reporting, and audit of CIFs.

For a group of teachers, what angered them was the revelation of the use of public funds to surveil teachers and learners. “That P112.5 million could have gone a long way towards repairing damaged classrooms, providing additional teacher allowances, and addressing the lack of restrooms, chairs, and books, among others,” Ruby Bernardo, chairperson of the Alliance of Concerned Teachers (ACT) Philippines, said in Filipino.

Read: Education at a crossroads ahead of Marcos Jr.’s SONA

ACT Philippines cited earlier reports that only 192 new classrooms were completed out of the target of more than 6,000 in 2023 when Duterte was still the education secretary, as well as having only 208 classrooms repaired out of more than 7,000 classrooms in need of rehabilitation.

During the impeachment trial on August 4, the prosecution panel presented the approved Physical and Financial Plan of DepEd for the first three quarters of 2023. The document showed its specified programs, including counter-insurgency, abuse prevention and control, anti-illegal activities operations, and anti-terrorism and extremism, with a total of P112.5 million in confidential funds or P37.5 million for each quarter.

For counter-insurgency and anti-terrorism and extremism programs, among the target outcomes based on the plan were to prevent the recruitment of the New People’s Army (NPA) and other communist and leftist groups in schools and to intensify the background investigation of DepEd personnel and learners involved in terrorist organizations.

ACT denounced the use of public funds in such activities, stressing that counter-insurgency has never been a mandate of DepEd. “To impeach Sara Duterte is justified. She must be held accountable for misusing OVP and DepEd funds for operations that have nothing to do with improving the quality of education in the country,” Bernardo said.

Wamil, who was assigned in COA-ICFAU from 2014 to 2024, said that he only audited the DepEd during the leadership of Duterte as education secretary as this was the only time that the agency had confidential funds.

Liza Idiang, a public school head at Balongbalong Elementary School in Pitogo, Zamboanga del Sur, earlier told Bulatlat how alleged state surveillance affected the mental health of already-exhausted teachers.

Idiang, who also serves as the chairperson of ACT Zamboanga Peninsula Region, made this remark after individuals who introduced themselves as state agents visited her and other teachers’ residences and their school in the latter part of July, asking if they were planning a protest action for the State of the Nation Address (SONA).

Read: State surveillance adds to teachers’ multiple burden

Former ACT Teachers Party-list Rep. France Castro said during the Bantay Impeachment program of the People’s Alternative Media Network (Altermidya) that DepEd’s use of confidential funds in counter-insurgency raises questions, especially to an agency that governs basic and secondary education. “You would look for terrorists in elementary and high school?”

Based on the DepEd’s accomplishment reports presented by prosecution to the impeachment court, Wamil said that there were items that were not allowable expenditures for CIFs under the said joint circular, including payments of incentives for traveling relative to the confidential operations and the provision of food and medicines.

author: Randi Beers
title: In Iqaluit or Pangnirtung? You may see more military activity this month
content:
People in Iqaluit and Pangnirtung might notice military activity in the area, as the Canadian Armed Forces begins Operation Nanook-Qimaavivut.


The Canadian military, alongside German Armed Forces members, are training on airfield assessment and reconnaissance activities until Sept. 1, the Canadian Armed Forces announced Thursday in a news release.


“The activity will focus on evaluating aviation infrastructure and operating conditions in northern environments for future Canadian and Allied operations,” the release said.


These activities started Wednesday in Pangnirtung and Friday in Iqaluit.


People might see Canadian or German military personnel at airport facilities in the area. They might have firearms — solely for wildlife protection, the release said.


There is no disruption to essential services expected, with minimal impact to the public.

author: Christine Ahn
title: Trump Moves to Scale Back US War Drills in Korea. We Should Support That.
content:
While any diplomatic overture from Trump should be viewed with skepticism, we should welcome a chance to advance peace.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

President Donald Trump’s social media post on August 16 calling for a substantial reduction in U.S.-South Korea military exercises triggered panic across partisan lines. Instead of just pointing to the high costs of the exercises and unnecessarily hostile approach towards North Korea, Trump also highlighted his “very good relationship with Kim Jong Un” and chastised South Korea for refusing to join the disastrous U.S.-Israel war on Iran. Attacks came from Republicans, including North Carolina Sen. Thom Tillis, who defended South Korea as “a solid military ally for over 70 years,” but then made the bizarre claim that reducing joint war drills frees up North Korean troops “to support Putin’s” war on Ukraine.

Democrats, naturally, piled on, attacking Trump for undermining yet another major ally to side with an authoritarian leader. Hillary Clinton, the champion of the failed policy of “strategic patience” during the Obama administration, posted: “The president is making US policy friendlier to North Korea and Russia than Canada and Oman. Are you kidding me?”

While any diplomatic overture from this administration should be viewed with skepticism — this is, after all, the same White House that condemned South Korea for declining to join its war against Iran — progressives shouldn’t miss an opportunity to take a principled position that advances peace, a reduced U.S. military footprint, and the security of the American and Korean people.

First and foremost, reducing tensions with North Korea is the right policy. Period. The United States has been at war with North Korea since the Korean War was temporarily halted in 1953 when the United States signed a ceasefire. This has meant that the United States is still technically at war with North Korea, justifying the presence of roughly 28,500 U.S. troops on dozens of U.S. military bases and installations on the Korean Peninsula. To maintain “readiness,” the U.S. and South Korean militaries regularly conduct provocative war drills involving tens of thousands of troops simulating the invasion of North Korea with the use of B-2 nuclear bombers, nuclear-powered aircraft carriers, and submarines. These joint military exercises are a well-known source of tension with North Korea as they have included training for “decapitation” strikes against the leadership, invasions, and preemptive strikes. Far from deterring North Korea, these exercises may do the opposite. Research suggests that these war drills tend to escalate rather than ease tensions, provoking a more threatening security environment instead of the deterrent effect they’re intended to have.

Second, Seoul has been calling for peaceful coexistence with Pyongyang and has abandoned the idea that North Korea would have to give up its nuclear program before dialogue. On July 23, Unification Minister Chung Dong-young announced South Korea’s “peace-first” approach, which aims instead at freezing North Korea’s nuclear program through a three-step process: halt the production of new weapons, reduce the stockpile, and end with dismantlement. South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has a phrase for the fact that North Korea is never going to give up its nuclear weapons: “harsh reality.”

Given this reality, President Lee has been nudging Trump to do exactly this. At the June 2026 G7 summit in Evian, France, a 90-minute dinner conversation between Presidents Trump and Lee produced commitments from both leaders to a peaceful resolution of North Korean issues — notably, without invoking denuclearization.

Seoul, then, is not an ally being blindsided, regardless of Trump’s lashing out about the Iran war. This is an ally that has been asking for exactly this shift, and finally has a U.S. president willing to upend the Washington political-military-industrial complex establishment that views South Korea as its floating aircraft carrier.

That’s where the so-called sacrament of the “alliance” deserves scrutiny. The narrative that Trump is abandoning South Korea obscures a longer, less flattering story about the actual purpose of the U.S. military presence there. Since 2006, when Washington and Seoul formalized the concept of “strategic flexibility” for U.S. Forces Korea …

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: How Trump Admin Weaponized "Antisemitism" Probes to Dismantle Higher Education "Brick by Brick"
content:
Haley Van Erem, a former career attorney in the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, has filed a complaint claiming the Trump administration task force charged with investigating antisemitism pushed universities into massive settlements despite turning up little to no evidence of anti-Jewish discrimination on campus. Van Erem said in her complaint that the government’s probes into schools like Harvard, Brown and Columbia were “an unlawful process designed to achieve predetermined political goals.”


“Columbia affiliates, from the Board of Trustees down, have actually collaborated with the federal government in these sham investigations,” says Marianna Hirsch, professor emerita at Columbia University. “These were not probes into antisemitism accusations, but they were efforts to dismantle higher education brick by brick.” Columbia and Brown settled with the administration for $200 million and $50 million, respectively. Harvard refused to settle, and a judge threw out the case against the university.

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: Groups oppose planned anti-terrorism hub in Zamboanga del Sur
content:
Soldiers from the United States, the Philippines, and Australia conduct cold load training as part of the Balikatan exercise. Photo from US Embassy in the Philippines Facebook page

Counterterrorism is again being used as a pretext to justify and normalize growing US military presence in the country.

CAGAYAN DE ORO — Multisectoral and human rights groups opposed plans to establish a United States (US)-backed counterterrorism hub in Pagadian City, Zamboanga del Sur.

Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) and Karapatan stressed that this initiative may result in US participation in the country’s counterinsurgency campaign that could worsen violations of human rights and international humanitarian law (IHL).

“Currently, Philippine police forces are already being assailed for their increasingly repressive handling of protesters,” Cristina Palabay, Karapatan secretary-general, said in a statement.

Read: ‘Overkill’ | Groups slam police arrests of activists during SONA 2026 protest

On July 30, the US Embassy in the Philippines and the Zamboanga del Sur provincial government signed a memorandum of agreement (MOA) for a P30.8 million (US$500,000) counterterrorism program under the US Department of State’s Anti-Terrorism Assistance (ATA) program.

The US-led initiative includes establishing “permanent and dedicated” training facilities reportedly within the Provincial Government Complex (PGC) in Barangay Dao, Pagadian City that would provide special training courses on counterterrorism to around 2,000 personnel of the Philippine National Police (PNP) annually.

Speaking with reporters during the MOA signing, US Embassy in the Philippines Spokesperson Jameson DeBose did not directly answer the question as to why they chose Zamboanga del Sur.

Bayan and Karapatan also viewed this initiative as an expansion of the presence of US forces in the southern part of the country, noting the existing Lumbia Air Base in Cagayan de Oro which is a designated military site under the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA) of the Philippine and US governments, as well as other military bases in Zamboanga City.

“Counterterrorism is again being used as a pretext to justify and normalize growing US military presence in the country and escalating US intervention in the Philippines’ internal affairs,” Palabay said.

Read: Philippines as a US military base?

Progressive groups have criticized the Marcos Jr. administration for its recent partnerships with the US. Aside from the continuing implementation of EDCA, they also opposed the plan to establish a military oil depot within the Davao Gulf and the controversial US-led Pax Silica initiative that would establish a 1,600-hectare industrial hub in New Clark City in Capas, Tarlac.

They said that these undermine the nation’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. They also expressed concerns that these engagements with the US could turn the country into a launching pad for attacks.

Karapatan called on both chambers of the 20th Congress to look into this another engagement involving the US. (DAA)

author: Act for freedom now!
title: Berlin (Germany): Vehicles Belonging to a War Profiteer Set on Fire
content:
A Fiery Disarmament Measure at Telekom!

“Arms manufacturing is a new business sector that Deutsche Telekom intends to develop, and in which it sees strong growth potential.”

What Deutsche Telekom CEO Tim Höttges refers to here as “growth potential” means nothing other than: war is a lucrative business, and the company wants its share of the pie. With the development of IT services for defense and security agencies, this semi-public company has long embodied the intertwining of civilian and military technologies.

But this new push into the arms market takes on a distinctly new dimension, and Deutsche Telekom thus finds itself in excellent company. Germany wants to prepare for war, and in this context, its struggling industrial sector is indeed shifting its focus toward defense. For example, tanks are expected to roll off the production lines soon at the Volkswagen plant in Osnabrück and at the Alstom rail manufacturer in Görlitz, while Rheinmetall plans to begin production of corresponding artillery ammunition as early as July at the former Pierburg plant in Wedding. For its part, Telekom plans to develop, in collaboration with Rheinmetall, a defense shield against drones. Through its 2-billion-euro technology fund, the company is also acquiring a stake in the defense technology startup Quantum Systems, which builds autonomous combat and surveillance drones.

We cannot let all this go unanswered: that’s why, last night, we reduced Deutsche Telekom’s vehicle fleet by six cars in Berlin’s Alt-Hohenschönhausen neighborhood. They didn’t count on us. We refuse to give up our neighborhoods for their weapons production, nor do we want to die on the front lines as cannon fodder for the rulers.

Solidarity greetings to the Ulm 5 and to all the other anti-militarists whom the cops have been harassing lately! Against all war—Against all genocide! Fuck military service—Fuck the Bundeswehr [German army]! Let’s attack militarization and the dystopia of AI surveillance! And as always: Let’s defend Rigaer94!

You have the power, we have the night!

title: Mazloum Abdi: SDF enters a new phase in the integration of military and administrative institutions
content:
The 100th anniversary of the founding of the city of Qamishlo was celebrated at Azadi Park with the participation of thousands of people, as well as SDF and Autonomous Administration officials and a delegation from the Syrian Transitional Government.


Speaking at the celebrations, Qamishlo Municipality co-mayor Berivan Omer greeted the participants and highlighted the city’s historical importance, its multicultural character and its role in a culture of coexistence.


Qamishlo represents the history and diversity of the region


Speaking afterward, SDF General Commander Mazloum Abdi said that the peoples of the region, with all their different components, had lived together for more than a century. Abdi said the construction of Qamishlo reflected the continuity and diversity of the cultures of the region’s peoples and their coexistence, adding that the city represents the history and all the components of Syrian Jazira.


Abdi said that during the Baath regime, chauvinist policies had been implemented aimed at altering the region’s demographic structure and Arabizing it. He stated that the Autonomous Administration had been struggling against these policies for 15 years and seeking to restore the region’s identity.


The SDF was established through people resistance


Recalling that the region had witnessed a devastating war in recent years, Abdi said the people had defended themselves against attacks and that the SDF had been established during this period of resistance.


Emphasizing that the SDF emerged as a result of the people’s resistance, Abdi commemorated the Kurdish forces and their fighters who fought against attacks on the region. He respectfully commemorated all the fighters who lost their lives while defending the people and saluted the region’s population for its 15 years of resistance.


A new phase has begun


Abdi said that with the fall of the Baath regime, a new phase had begun for the construction of a new Syria, adding that the decision to join the New Syria had been taken on the basis of the 29 January Agreement.


Abdi said that the integration of the military, security and administrative institutions established in recent years into state institutions was being carried out in a way that would preserve their identities and gains. He said: “The phase of integrating the military, security and administrative institutions into the state institutions has come to an end, and a new phase has begun as of today.”


Abdi called on the people of the region to protect and support the institutions built through the sacrifices of the martyrs.


The struggle to ensure constitutional guarantees for rights will continue


Abdi said the struggle to guarantee the rights of the Kurdish people and all components of Syria would continue, adding that political efforts would be intensified at the current stage.


Abdi stressed that the political struggle would continue to ensure that the legitimate rights of the Kurds and all other components are guaranteed in Syria’s new constitution. Saying that Qamishlo could in the future become a center of culture, politics and diversity, Abdi concluded by calling on all the components of the region to work together to build a peaceful future.

author: Unknown
title: Trump'ın İran'a ekonomik savaş ilanı: Hedefte Çin mi var?
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump’ın İran’a yardım eden veya İran’la iş yapan her ülkeye ekonomik savaş başlatacağı açıklaması dün güne damgasını vurdu. Açıklama ABD’nin iç borcunun ilk defa 40 trilyon doları aştığı ve ülkede Trump’ın ekonomi yönetimine tepkilerin arttığı gün geldi. İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Arakçi de Trump’ın hamlesini “Washington’un eşi görülmemiş borçları ve hızla artan faiz maliyetlerinden dikkatleri başka yöne çekmek için tasarlandığını” söyledi. Öte yandan Trump’ın “ekonomik savaşı”nın asıl olarak İran’ın en büyük ticari ortağı Çin’i hedef aldığı tartışılıyor. Keza Çin’den tepki gecikmedi. Çin Dışişleri “Yaptırım uygulamak ve baskı yapmak sorunun çözümüne yardımcı olmuyor” açıklaması yaptı.

ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, İran’a yönelik eşi benzeri görülmemiş boyutta bir ekonomik operasyon ilan ettiğini belirterek, Tahran yönetimine destek veren ülkeleri de ağır ekonomik sonuçlarla karşılaşmakla tehdit etti. Trump hamlesini “Economic D-Day” olarak adlandırdı. “D-Day” Amerika Silahlı Kuvvetlerince askeri harekâtın başlangıç günü anlamıyla kullanılmış olan bir terim.

Trump, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, İran’ın anlaşma fırsatını değerlendiremediğini belirterek, “Bu nedenle bugün, herhangi bir ülkeye karşı şimdiye kadar uygulanmış en ezici ekonomik ‘D-Day’ ilan ediyorum. Bu, eşi benzeri görülmemiş ölçekte ekonomik savaş ve izolasyon olacak” ifadelerini kullandı.

Trump, şöyle devam etti: “Bugün ayrıca, finans kuruluşlarının, şirketlerin, havalimanlarının veya devlet kurumlarının İran’a herhangi bir tür can simidi sağlamasına izin veren herhangi bir ülkenin de muazzam ekonomik sonuçlarla karşı karşıya kalacağını ilan ediyorum. Petrol kaçakçılığı, swap hatları, nakit transferleri, döviz büroları, gemi sicilleri, paravan şirketler, bunların hepsinin derhal sonlandırılması gerekiyor. Kim olduğunuzu biliyorsunuz.”

İran tehdidini izole etmek ve yenilgiye uğratmak için tüm müttefiklerin ABD’nin yanında durmasına ihtiyaç olduğunun altını çizen Trump, İran’ın köşeye sıkıştığını ve bu tarihi önlemlerin ülkenin “dünya genelinde terör yayma kabiliyetlerini” felce uğratacağını ifade etti.

Öte yandan Trump’ın açıklamasının zamanlaması dikkat çekti. Trump açıklamayı, savunma harcamaları, sosyal programlar ve artan faiz ödemelerinin etkisiyle ABD’nin kamu borcunun ilk kez 40 trilyon doları aştığı gün yaptı.

Trump, 2024 başkanlık kampanyasında kamu harcamalarını azaltma sözü vermişti.

ABD Hazine Bakanlığının açıkladığı 40.05 trilyon dolar kamu borcu, Kongre Bütçe Ofisi'nin toplam borcun 2026 mali yılının sonunda 39.4 trilyon dolara ulaşacağı yönündeki önceki tahminini de aştı.

Cumhuriyetçi Senatör Rick Scott, Kongreye “harcamaları kontrol altına alma ve bütçeyi denkleştirme” çağrısı yaparak, “Amerikalılar daha iyisini hak ediyor,” diye yazdı.

Demokrat Senatör Mark Kelly ise Trump’ı ulusal borcu artırırken kendisini zenginleştirmekle suçladı. Kelly, “Başkan, ilk döneminde borcun tamamını ödeyeceğini söylemişti. Bunun yalan olduğunu hepimiz biliyorduk,” dedi. Trump’ın kendisi ve ailesi milyarlar kazanırken borcu 40 trilyon dolara çıkardığını söyledi. Demokrat Temsilciler Meclisi Üyesi Ted Lieu da Trump’ı “Borçta Altın Çağ’ı başlatmakla” suçladı.

Öte yandan Trump’ın ekonomik savaş ilanına İran’dan tepkiler gecikmedi. İran’ın hukuk ve uluslararası ilişkilerden sorumlu Dışişleri Bakan Yardımcısı Kazem Garibabadi, ABD’nin “yanlış hesaplamalar” yaptığı belirtti. X’teki paylaşımında Garibabadi, “Her seferinde bunu örtbas etmek için kendilerine daha büyük bir yenilgi yaşatmak zorunda kalıyorlar. Askeri savaş işe yaramadı, bu yüzden şimdi bir sonraki başarısızlığa ‘ekonomik savaş’ adını verdiler.”

İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Arakçi de, Trump’ın ekonomik savaş hamlesini ABD’nin iç meselelerinden dikkatleri başka yöne çekme çabası olarak nitelendirdi. X’te yaptığı bir paylaşımda Arakçi, bu hamlenin Washington’un “eşi görülmemiş borçları ve hızla artan faiz maliyetlerinden” dikkatleri başka yöne çekmek için tasarlandığını belirterek, “Başarısız politikalara daha da fazla ağırlık vermenin sadece daha fazla yenilgiye yol açacağı” uyarısında bulundu. Arakçi, ABD’nin “ekonomik terörizminin küresel ekonomiyi ve dünya çapındaki egemenlikleri tehdit ettiğini” de sözlerine ekledi.

Öte yandan İran’ı askeri olarak yenemeyen Trump’ın ekonomik savaşının hedefinin ise Çin olduğu tartışılıyor. Katar’daki Georgetown Üniversitesi’nde siyaset bilimi doçenti olan Paul Musgrave, Al Jazeera’ya yaptığı açıklamada, yeni yaptırımların …

author: antimilitarismus
title: Despre dronele „de eliberare” care răspândesc teroarea
content:
În acest articol, vom încerca să explicăm de ce utilizarea dronelor de către armata ucraineană în misiuni de luptă este la fel de condamnabilă ca și utilizarea lor de către armata rusă. Vom începe cu un citat dintr-un cotidian ceh:

Războiul din ucraina s-a transformat în ultimele zile într-o luptă pentru infrastructura energetică. Rusia distruge sistematic instalațiile de gaze ucrainene din regiunea Harkov, în timp ce dronele ucrainene lovesc ținte aflate adânc pe teritoriul rus. Atacurile aeriene nocturne de la periferia Moscovei au provocat rănirea a zece persoane, printre care trei cetățeni chinezi. În Podolsk, dronele au lovit clădiri civile și o autostradă, rănind încă două femei. De asemenea, o fetiță de 11 ani a fost nevoită să solicite îngrijiri medicale din cauza unei reacții severe de stres. – sursa: https://ekonomickydenik.cz/ukrajinske-drony-ruske-vnitrozemi-zraneni-cizinci/

Ce concluzii politice și strategice trag susținătorii „rezistenței poporului ucrainean” din toate acestea? Nu observăm aici nicio auto-reflecție critică. Perspectiva lor rămâne la fel de tragică ca întotdeauna. În primul rând, potrivit acestora, rusia este singurul agresor în acest război. În al doilea rând, ei continuă să ceară „mai mult echipament militar pentru armata ucraineană”, despre care susțin că apără exclusiv populația civilă ucraineană. În al treilea rând, aceștia continuă să strângă fonduri pentru producătorii și piloții dronelor ucrainene, pe care le descriu drept instrumente de eliberare și mijloace de apărare.

Atacurile armatei ucrainene cu ajutorul dronelor au provocat în repetate rânduri răniți, morți și traume în rândul civililor din rusia. Mass-media pro-ucraineană, inclusiv cea etichetată drept anarhistă, declară însă în unanimitate: „Ucraina se apără de cinci ani împotriva agresiunii ruse”. Astfel, se consideră agresiune atunci când armata rusă bombardează infrastructura din Harkov, dar când armata ucraineană bombardează infrastructură similară în rusia, este un act de autoapărare. (1)

Am căuta în zadar vreo diferență substanțială între ceea ce luptătorii pro-ucraineni și susținătorii lor consideră a fi apărare și ceea ce oamenii cu bun simț privesc, în general, ca pe un atac nemilos asupra unor oameni nevinovați. Este clar că ambele părți — rusia și ucraina — sunt la fel în această privință. Fiecare parte o acuză pe cealaltă că răspândește teroarea, în timp ce descrie teroarea pe care o provoacă ea însăși drept autoapărare necesară.

Aceasta este, pur și simplu, esența propagandei și a practicii războiului. Clasele conducătoare și acoliții lor de toate părțile răspândesc distrugerea, dar clasa muncitoare — care nu are niciun interes în a purta război — este cea care suferă cel mai mult de pe urma consecințelor acestuia. Acest lucru este foarte bine sintetizat de un comentariu postat recent într-un fir de discuție de sub un podcast de pe site-ul ANews. În acest podcast a avut loc o discuție despre un interviu controversat în care Margaret Killjoy îi adresează întrebări unei persoane pe nume Kafa, care pilotează drone în cadrul operațiunilor militare ucrainene și descrie acest lucru ca fiind singura strategie anarhistă corectă în timpul războiului. O persoană dezgustată de acest interviu a scris următoarele în cadrul discuției:

Pentru context: m-am născut în Rusia și am trăit în Statele Unite aproape toată viața. Cea mai mare parte a familiei mele locuiește încă în Rusia. Aud destul de des povești despre ce se întâmplă cu ei acolo. Nu pot să îi vizitez personal, pentru că există riscul să fiu recrutat dacă aș face asta.

În prezent, am rude în două orașe care sunt atacate de drone ucrainene. Aud că vărul meu se teme să meargă la școală, iar bunica mea îmi descrie sunetul dronelor în timp ce îmi povestește despre starea ei cronică de sănătate cardiacă. Mama mea suferă de atacuri de panică de ani de zile, deoarece posibilitatea ca familia noastră să fie ucisă înainte să apucăm să-i vedem din nou este foarte reală. De obicei, nu vorbesc despre asta cu prietenii mei. Majoritatea oamenilor nu au nimic de spus când aduc vorba despre asta. Știu că situația mea este mult mai puțin gravă decât cea prin care trec oamenii din Ucraina. Nu mă consider în măsură să vorbesc despre cum este să trăiești sub o ocupație militară activă, într-o zonă de război activă.

Acestea fiind spuse, mi-e foarte, foarte greu să accept ideea că, de cealaltă parte a unei drone care o sperie de moarte pe bunica mea, se află un anarhist …

author: A.N.A.
title: [Uruguai] Reivindicação do ataque com artefato explosivo à Caixa Militar em Montevidéu
content:
À meia-noite do dia 15 de junho deste ano, detonamos um artefato explosivo na Caixa de Aposentadorias e Pensões das Forças Armadas, em Montevidéu, Uruguai. Ele foi fabricado com materiais acessíveis e acionado por um sistema mecânico simples.


A Caixa Militar é uma manifestação clara de como o poder nos rouba, nos explora e nos reprime. Uma caixa que é subsidiada com o sangue de todos para manter bem alimentados e subornados os militares que, se for o caso, atirarão contra a revolta.


Arrastamos correntes, vivemos raspando o fundo de nossos salários para alimentar a máquina da exploração. O capital e as forças repressivas andam sempre de mãos dadas para sugar nossa vida e, caso nos rebelemos: matar, torturar e fazer desaparecer.


Escolhemos mirar na infraestrutura de nossas misérias e angústias. Não é a vizinha, não é quem vive na rua, não são os viciados, nem o ladrão de pouca monta. Não são os garotos que acabam aos pés do traficante. O inimigo é um punhado de privilegiados, é a autoridade, são os hierarcas e os partidos políticos que se beneficiam da administração de seu feudo.


Eles sabem onde estão.


Aqui, os torturadores são uma instituição completa, fazendo aquilo para o que existem: proteger os interesses dos ricos e poderosos. Os militares, antes e durante a ditadura, agiram de acordo com sua razão de ser, não como uma exceção. Aqui, no Congo ou no Haiti, não houve erros, não houve excessos; a função do exército é garantir a exploração.


Este ano, eles tiveram grande destaque. Enviaram tanques para os bairros. Não sem antes passear e agasalhar o exército colonial pelo território, brincando de guerra em seus porta-aviões. O senhor gosta de brincar de guerra, senhor presidente?


A ministra classificou essa ação como um fato isolado. Pelo contrário, essa ação se insere na longa trajetória de luta contra a opressão. É uma memória ativa contra os carrascos que vocês protegem e comandam. Os rebeldes desaparecidos, torturados e presos de ontem e de hoje estão presentes na ação direta, no confronto com o capital e com o Estado que o protege. Mil funerais com mil pessoas em silêncio não compensam o abandono da luta.


Na noite de 15 de junho ficou evidente, mais uma vez, que é possível atacar de forma contundente, que o panóptico de vocês não nos observa o tempo todo, que há fendas mais do que suficientes para transformar o tédio e a raiva em rebeldia. É só uma questão de colocar a mão na massa.


A repressão não se manifesta apenas na forma de botas militares. As telas são correntes; a ofensiva se distrai nelas.


No Rio da Prata, há lenha que queima sem fumaça. Por meio de tentativa e erro, com determinação e cautela, com o que estiver à mão. Monte sua banda!


Sara Ardizzone, Alessandro Mercogliano, Kyriakos Ximitris, Mauricio Morales e Santiago Maldonado na memória ativa.

author: A.N.A.
title: [Itália] Antiespecismo, veganismo e crise climática
content:
O verão que estamos vivendo está nos mostrando de forma tremendamente tangível o quanto nossas atividades destrutivas estão impactando o clima terrestre. Não há parte do mundo que não esteja sofrendo com desconfortos, ou mesmo verdadeiros desastres, climáticos. Em nosso país, ondas de calor tropical se sucedem, causando cada vez mais incêndios (quando não são criminosos), eventos climáticos extremos e fazendo diminuir assustadoramente o nível da água dos rios e lagos.


Nossa casa comum, a Terra, está doente e o vírus que a infectou somos nós.

 Um conceito mais que banal e totalmente evidente. Apesar de tudo isso, no âmbito antiespecista e vegano, este assunto tão dramaticamente urgente quase nunca é abordado. No entanto, toda vez que uma floresta pega fogo, morrem milhões de Animais, assim como também ocorre com deslizamentos, enxurradas, alagamentos, transbordamentos, longos períodos de seca e tempestades. As zonas climáticas estão mudando rapidamente e isso também significa o desaparecimento de muitas espécies animais que não conseguirão mais se adaptar ao novo clima. Como é que não paramos para refletir sobre tudo isso?


A 

Questão Animal

 diz respeito a todas as áreas da ação humana, a todas as suas implicações e consequências, portanto, também e principalmente, aos desastres climáticos que estamos causando com a poluição, o enorme desperdício de energia, as atividades extrativistas, a poluição, a exploração dos ecossistemas e a antropização e destruição dos habitats naturais. Não considerar tudo isso sob uma ótica antiespecista e vegana, para tentar combater este fenômeno gravíssimo e complexo que produzimos diretamente, é simplesmente uma loucura.


Se a nossa função, enquanto pessoas humanas antiespecistas, é retirar os Animais da exploração humana e, por fim, chegar à tão almejada libertação, não podemos nos eximir de compreender o quanto a crise climática está impactando de forma devastadora a vida dos seres vivos terrestres.


Cada vez mais, a mídia nos mostra imagens de rios secos; toda vez que um rio desaparece, deixando apenas um leito vazio e seco, desaparecem também milhões de Animais, plantas, muitos outros organismos vivos que o habitavam e outros que dependiam de sua presença: quando um rio morre, com ele morre um mundo inteiro, é um grande e vital amigo que se foi. Não podemos ser tão estúpidos e insensíveis a ponto de não compreender isso.


Temos o dever e a urgência de incluir no leque de reflexões e intervenções do nosso ativismo conceitos básicos de ecologia: certamente não aquela especista, antropocêntrica e superficial que nos é empurrada diariamente, mas a 

ecologia profunda

 não antropocêntrica, útil para nos ajudar finalmente a entender o quão frágil e ameaçada está a rede da vida na Terra.


Adriano Fragano


Fonte: 

https://www.manifestoantispecista.org/web/antispecismo-veganismo-e-crisi-climatica/

title: 1,500 mink escape from Oregon farm after fence is cut open reportedly by extremist animal rights group
content:
Roughly 1,500 mink escaped an Oregon farm after a hole was cut in a fence — with an extremist animal rights group linking themselves to the plot to free the creatures, according to authorities and reports.

The scores of mink were intentionally let loose from Cascade Farm in Turner late last Wednesday night as the farm’s manager, his wife, children, and other employees were sleeping, KOIN reported.

The suspected intruders cut a hole in a chain-link fence enclosure, allowing the mink to roam free, the local outlet said.

The Animal Liberation Front — a decentralized group of international animal rights advocates labeled as extremists by the FBI — appears to have taken responsibility for the break-in, the outlet reported.

In a press release, the radical group said they have yet to receive an “anonymous communique” officially taking credit for the action.

But Jerry Vlasak, a spokesperson for the North American Animal Liberation Front, told the outlet that the mink escape plot was consistent with their group’s actions and that communiques from activists claiming responsibility are not always sent.

The farm owners have since recovered about 90% of the cute, semiaquatic mammals, the Marion County Sheriff’s Office told the outlet.

“This wasn’t activism. It was a criminal act against a legally operated, certified farm,” Challis Hobbs, Executive Director of Fur Commission USA, an organization that represents mink farmers including Cascade Farm, told the outlet.

“The farm manager and his wife and children live on this property, along with other employees and their families,” he said. “It’s deeply unsettling to have people cut through a fence in the middle of the night with children sleeping just steps away.”

Cascade Farm raises mink legally for pelts and is Humane Care Certified. Any of the mink that aren’t recovered within 24 to 48 hours also face risk of starvation and death, Fur Commission USA added.

The animal activists, however, claimed the mink would be subjected to “egregiously cruel and violent” treatment in captivity.

“The animals liberated last night have a fighting chance at life; they faced a 100 percent death rate if they stayed on the farm,” the Animal Liberation Front wrote in a statement.

The group previously claimed responsibility for cutting open a fence at Olsen Fur Farm in Wisconsin in 2023, allowing about 3,000 mink to escape, CBS reported.

author: webadmin
title: Hunting: It’s No Child’s Play
content:
In 2023, the UN released General Comment No. 26. This document updates the famous UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. It explicitly states children must be kept safe from witnessing violence, including physical or psychological harm inflicted on animals. Yet every week across the UK children are taken out to participate in hunting, where they will be exposed to horrific levels of animal cruelty.


A small child is witness to a fox being dug out and thrown to waiting hounds.


On Boxing Day 2020 the Avon Vale Hunt were filmed digging out a fox and throwing her to waiting hounds. Tom Ledbury, the terrierman for this hunt, was sentenced to a 12-month community order for his role in this sickening act. Something equally horrifying is how a small child was present throughout the dig out.


Recent HSA articles have exposed the extent of indoctrination of children into the world of hunting. One of the most recent exposes is the

Stowe Beagles

 recent conviction for killing a hare. Kennel huntsman Philip Kennedy was convicted for the offence but drone footage shows students from Stowe School gloating and celebrating while the hare is mauled by hounds.


Is it part of Stowe Schools curriculum to encourage students to participate in the tearing apart of wildlife?


In November 2025 Lake District Hunt Sabs caught the horrifying moment the

Coniston Foxhounds

 dug out a fox with the use of a terrier, and carried her to waiting hounds. What is apparent from the footage is how co-ordinated the dig out was, a clear indication that this is a regular occurrence. What is also evident are the ages of some of the participants. While older members of the group are participating in the dig out, younger members are watching closely, enthusiastically waiting to get involved, with one of them being handed the terrified fox who he then carries and throws to hounds.


This youth gleefully grabbed the fox by the scruff of her neck and threw her to hounds.


As we know, animal cruelty is just one part of a hunt, there is much more anti-social behaviour and illegal activity that comes with it and this doesn’t stop just because a hunt is professing to have a children’s meet.


In February this year West Midlands Hunt Saboteurs reported of road chaos and violence at a Warwickshire Hunt children’s meet. While hunting in Little Kineton gamekeeper Michael Collins physically assaulted a saboteur. This was followed by hunt master Olivia Forsyth purposely blocking the busy B4455 while she ranted and raved, before eventually being moved on by police.


What a great example to set for children.


It’s not just fox and hare hunting that indoctrinates children; they are exposed to animal cruelty at all blood sports. Just this weekend, at the Dove Valley Mink Hounds, children as young as 11 were present, with one as young as 14 carrying a T-bar and a shovel, ready and waiting to participate in the tormenting of mink and otters.


What a wonderful way to spend the summer holidays, learning how to terrorise and abuse the local wildlife.


As the UN states, children should be kept safe from witnessing all forms of violence, including that inflicted upon animals. What the above examples show are that children are not only witnessing this violence, they are active participants from a very young age, being taught that this is acceptable and being encouraged to be complicit in breaking the law.


The problem is the adults teaching them were subject to the same indoctrination and so a cycle has been formed. A cycle of barbaric violence and law breaking which is dressed up as ‘tradition.’ There are some things that should not be passed onto children and blood sports is one of them.

Hunting: It’s No Child’s Play

Hunt Saboteurs Association

author: GPT
title: Der Bauernverband gibt der Ernährungsinitiative recht
content:
Am 27. September 2026 können die Stimmberechtigten der Schweiz über die Ernährungsinitiative abstimmen.


Hier meine persönliche Meinung zu dieser Initiative: diese Initiative möchte, dass der Anteil in der Schweiz produzierter und konsumierter pflanzlicher Lebensmittel steigt und schlägt vor, über die Förderung des Anbaus und des Konsums solcher Lebensmittel einen Selbstversorgungsgrad von 70% anzustreben.


Das ist ein sinnvolles Anliegen, das sich für eine ressourceneffizientere und somit nachhaltigere Landwirtschaft einsetzt: aktuell wird in der Schweiz auf Ackerland viel Tierfutter angebaut in Form von Futtermais, Futtergetreide und Futterrüben. Es wäre viel sinnvoller und effizienter auf diesen Flächen stattdessen Lebensmittel für die menschliche Ernährung anzubauen. Erst recht da wir in der Schweiz eine Unterversorgung haben an Getreide und Leguminosen für die menschliche Ernährung und diese im grossen Stil importieren, während bei tierischen Produkten teilweise gar grosse Mengen exportiert werden müssen, weil in der Schweiz die Nachfrage nicht genügt.


Obwohl das Anliegen der Initiative vernünftig und nachhaltig ist, macht die Gegnerschaft schon seit geraumer Zeit mit absurden Parolen wie «Nein zum Veganzwang!» Stimmung gegen diese Initiative. Und sie macht das so erfolgreich, dass inzwischen sogar der Umweltverband Pro Natura, welcher die Initiative anfangs unterstützte, wohl aus Angst vor einem Imageschaden die Nein-Parole beschlossen hat. Ein sehr bemerkenswerter Vorgang bei einem ökologischen Anliegen.


Trotz der reisserischen Parolen lohnt es sich, die Argumente der Gegnerschaft genauer anzuschauen: Unter dem Titel vom «Veganzwang» argumentiert der Bauernverband, dass ein Selbstversorgungsgrad von 70% nur durch eine vegane oder nahezu vegane Ernährung möglich wäre. Ja, richtig gelesen: der Bauernverband sagt, dass durch vegane Ernährung ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad möglich wäre. Das ist eine wilde 180°-Wende zu pflanzenbasierter Ernährung: von Verteidiger:innen der Nutztierhaltung hiess es bis anhin fast durchs Band, dass vegane Ernährung in der Schweiz keinen Sinn mache, da aufgrund des Grünlandes in der Schweiz bei einem höheren Anteil pflanzlicher Ernährung der Selbstversorgungsgrad sinken würde. Nun bestätigt also der Bauernverband, dass mit einem höheren Anteil pflanzlicher Lebensmittel ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad möglich wäre. Er bestätigt damit auch, dass die aktuelle Schweizer Landwirtschaft in hohem Mass Ressourcenverschwendung betreibt. Und er gibt damit inhaltlich auch der Initiative Recht: mit mehr pflanzlichen Lebensmitteln wäre ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad und eine ressourceneffizientere Landwirtschaft möglich.


Das einzige, was der Bauernverband gegen die Initiative sagt, ist also, dass er das nicht möchte. Er möchte lieber die aktuellen verschwenderischen landwirtschaftlichen Förderstrukturen beibehalten, anstatt den Anbau von pflanzlichen Lebensmitteln zu fördern, die nachhaltiger wären und für die es in der Schweiz tatsächlich einen Bedarf und eine Nachfrage gäbe.


Dass der Bauernverband trotz dem offenen Eingestehen, dass ihre Landwirtschaft nicht nachhaltig ist, die Stimmung so prägen kann, dass selbst Pro Natura einknickt, sollte zu denken geben. Und zeigt meiner Meinung nach zwei Dinge: erstens welche Diskursmacht der eng mit den Wirtschaftsverbänden verbundene Bauernverband bei Landwirtschaftsthemen bis weit in linke und ökologische Kreise hinein hat. Und zweitens welch überhöhte, romantisierte und unantastbare Stellung die Tierhaltung und insbesondere die Rinderhaltung in der Schweizer Öffentlichkeit hat.


Darum umso dringender: JA am 27.9.26 zur Ernährungsinitiative!


Jann Krättli, Biohof Tannacker, Rechthalten

title: Découverte macabre : 300 cochons morts dans un élevage Eureden
content:
L214 publie des images d'un élevage porcin situé à Hénon et à Saint-Carreuc, dans les Côtes-d'Armor. L'exploitation, liée à la coopérative Eureden et récemment présentée comme un modèle d'avenir pour l'élevage porcin, révèle une situation catastrophique : plus de 300 cadavres de cochons et de porcelets (en décomposition avancée, corps momifiés ou déjà à l’état de squelettes). Un enfer où des cochons vivants se trouvent encore au milieu des morts. Pour L214, il s'agit de l'un des pires cas d'abandon d'animaux documentés par l'association. L'association porte plainte pour mauvais traitements et abandon d'animaux auprès du procureur de la République du tribunal judiciaire de Saint-Brieuc, signale les faits aux services de la préfecture des Côtes-d'Armor et demande au préfet la fermeture immédiate de l'exploitation.

Cette enquête montre 300 cadavres de cochons abandonnés dans les bâtiments d'un élevage situés dans les Côtes-d'Armor (Bretagne). Certains corps sont momifiés, d'autres sont réduits à l'état de squelettes. Des animaux sont morts depuis plusieurs semaines, certains depuis plusieurs mois. Il s'agit de l'un des pires cas d'abandon d'animaux documentés par l'association.

Quelques semaines avant la découverte de ces cadavres, cet élevage faisait l'objet d'une importante communication de la coopérative agro-industrielle Eureden. Le 19 juin 2026, une journée portes ouvertes y a réuni 550 personnes autour d'un des bâtiments, neuf et sans animaux, présenté comme l'avenir de l'élevage porcin, à la pointe de l'innovation et du « bien-être animal ». Derrière ces éléments de langage, les animaux sont pris au piège dans des bâtiment fermés privés de leurs besoins les plus fondamentaux, et laissés sans soin.

Nous demandons à Monsieur le préfet :

la fermeture immédiate de cet élevage ;

la mise à l'abri des animaux encore vivants ;

l'interdiction pour l'exploitant de détenir ou d'exercer une activité auprès d'animaux.

author: CNT Guadalajara
title: Bomberos Forestales veganos de Geacam queremos denunciar deficiencias en el avituallamiento del incendio de La Mierla
content:
Vaya por delante nuestro reconocimiento a la buena labor en general de la sección de logística desplegada para este incendio sabiendo lo complicado que puede llegar a ser con tal cantidad de efectivos, pero no podemos pasar por alto las deficiencias constatadas, con la intención de que estas sean subsanadas.


El avituallamiento en general ha sido bastante completo, café, leche, cacao y bollería en el Area de Espera, ensaladas de arroz, pasta, alubias y garbanzos, bocadillos variados (con alguna opción para vegetarianxs), flanes y puddings de chocolate y fruta.


Cada persona se llevaba un bocadillo a elegir, dos tuppers de ensalada a elegir, flan y pudding más dos piezas de fruta. Muy completo, variado y abundante.


Sin embargo, para lxs veganos ha sido un absoluto desastre, pareciera que al ser un colectivo poco representado en la empresa no se le presta la atención debida y obligada por ley.


Lxs veganxs, del avituallamiento detallado anteriormente, sólo podían coger tuppers de ensalada de alubias y garbanzos, además de piezas de fruta; y en el caso de lxs vegetarianos bocata de tortilla además de lo anterior. Del desayuno únicamente café sólo. Con el agravante de que las ensaladas referidas eran una lotería, al leer los ingredientes y alérgenos estaba claramente señalado que no contenían ningún tipo de producto animal, y sin embargo la gran mayoría de ellas contenían atún y pollo. Un error incomprensible y denunciable, es una vergüenza que una empresa de catering cometa un fallo de etiquetado tan burdo en los tiempos que corren.


Lejos de subsanarse tras señalarse desde los primeros días, incluso haciendo alguna sugerencia de opciones ofertadas años atrás, se ha convertido en norma, quedándose algún/x compañerx sin comer durante jornadas completas  en un incendio en el que hemos trabajado a destajo durante más de diez días.


Todas merecemos el mismo trato, y recibir un avituallamiento suficiente y nutritivo es algo esencial en un trabajo duro y extenuante, no se puede obviar esa necesidad, máxime cuando se ha señalado desde los primeros días para que se solucionara.


Solicitamos a Geacam que rescinda el contrato con la empresa de catering, o se asegure de que va a proporcionar un avituallamiento en condiciones de igualdad con el del resto de componentes del dispositivo para lxs veganxs y vegetarianxs, como es obligatorio por ley.

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

title: ‘They’re still there’: Activists warn of more mink raids after break-in at Oregon farm
content:
PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) — After a late-night break-in last week led to the escape of 1,500 mink from an Oregon farm, some animal rights activists say more intrusions could be on the way.

The Animal Liberation Front, a decentralized group of extremist animal rights advocates known for sabotage, vandalism and even arson, has claimed responsibility in a press release shared on its website for the Aug. 13 break-in at Cascade Farms of Oregon mink farm in Turner, Oregon.

That claim has been unconfirmed by officials. The Federal Bureau of Investigation’s Portland office declined to comment on whether it is investigating the break-in.

The Marion County Sheriff’s Office said there have been no arrests related to the case, and they have no information indicating the ALF’s involvement.

The owner of Cascade Farms of Oregon, Randy Lucas, did not respond to multiple phone calls seeking comment about the break-in. Cascade Farms was established by Lucas’ father, John Lucas, as a meat business and ranch in 1980. The meat business has since closed, and John Lucas passed away, but the ranch remains in business.

But Joseph Buddenberg, a former member of the Animal Liberation Front, said the break-in at Cascade Farm in Turner is consistent with an ALF action. Jerry Vlasak from the North American Animal Liberation press office, which represents the ALF in North America, also said it was consistent with an ALF action but has not received an anonymous communique taking credit for the action. Vlasak also said communiques are often submitted by activists days or even weeks after an event but sometimes aren’t sent at all.

“There have been over 100 fur farm raids in the United States dating back to the 1990s,” Buddenberg said. “Cutting the fences, opening cages, and destroying breeding records have been tactics historically utilized by the ALF.”

Buddenberg pleaded guilty in 2016 to conspiracy to violate the Animal Enterprise Terrorism Act after he and a partner were accused of terrorizing the fur industry during cross-country road trips. He has since completed his sentence and said he hopes speaking out can help people understand why activists go to such extreme lengths.

“Every summer we see activists break in to free mink from farms,” he said. “Every November, they’re pelted.”

Farmed mink are typically bred and raised early in the year until around November, when they’re harvested for their pelts, which are sold for luxury fur apparel and other items. The industry generated $28.1 million in pelts in 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Mink Survey.

Humanely certified operations use carbon monoxide gas, which immediately renders them unconscious and ensures they die quickly and without pain, according to the trade organization Fur Commission USA. The group estimates there are approximately 275 mink farms in 23 states across the U.S., and has said mink that are released often don’t survive.

“If they stayed on the farm, they’d have a 100% death rate,” he said. “Release at least gives them a chance at survival. Fur farmers should definitely expect to see more of this before November.”

Despite his previous felony conviction and time served, Buddenberg remains steadfast in his views.

“Opening cages and freeing these animals is the most compassionate thing you can do,” he said. “My mind hasn’t changed on that at all.”

Oregon’s mink farming industry is a shadow of what it once was. Data from the U.S. Department of Agriculture show Oregon had 37 mink farms in 1978. A decade later, in 1998, that number dropped to 30. By 2006, there were only 18 mink farms in Oregon. Since then, the USDA has stopped including the number of ranches in its reports. Some estimates say Oregon currently has around 11 mink farms. Others, including Buddenberg, estimate there are only about five left in the state, including Cascade.

“Actions like this have a history of closing fur farms,” Buddenberg said. “My hope is that this farm will close. Actions like this are very effective.”

The ALF claimed responsibility for multiple mink farm break-ins in Oregon in 2008, according to several reports published in the Oregonian and the Daily Astorian. They included a break-in at Jefferson Mink Farm in Jefferson, a break-in at S&N Fur Farm in Scio, and a break-in at Ylipelto’s Fur Farm in Astoria. In all three cases, fencing around the farm was cut, and the mink were released into the wild.

author: PETA-Team
title: Hayden Panettiere: Letzte PETA-Kampagne gegen Delfinarien
content:
Nur wenige Wochen vor ihrem Tod setzte sich Schauspielerin Hayden Panettiere gemeinsam mit PETA USA im Rahmen einer eindringlichen Kampagne gegen 

Delfinarien

 und 

Meeresparks

 wie SeaWorld ein. Für das Motiv legte sie sich in eine Badewanne, um auf Platzmangel aufmerksam zu machen, unter dem Delfine in Gefangenschaft leiden. 


PETA USA veröffentlicht die Kampagne im August 2026 in Erinnerung an Panettiere und ihren langjährigen Einsatz für Meeressäuger. Ihre zentrale Botschaft: Menschen sollten keine Tickets für Einrichtungen kaufen, die 

Delfine

 in kleinen Becken gefangen halten und zu touristischen Attraktionen degradieren. 


Hayden Panettiere zeigt, wie wenig Platz Delfine in Gefangenschaft haben 


In dem Kampagnenvideo verdeutlicht Panettiere, was Delfinen in Gefangenschaft genommen wird:  


In ihrem natürlichen Lebensraum können sie mit ihren Familien zusammenleben, große Distanzen zurücklegen, tief tauchen und sich frei im Meer bewegen. 


In Delfinarien dagegen sind die Tiere auf kleine Becken oder flache Lagunen beschränkt. 


Nicht nur in den USA werden Hunderte Delfine in solchen Anlagen gehalten. Dort werden sie beispielsweise gezwungen, 

„Kunststücke“ vorzuführen

 oder werden für 

touristische Begegnungen

 missbraucht, bei denen fremde Menschen sie immer wieder anfassen. Die Delfine haben dabei keine Möglichkeit, sich zurückzuziehen. 


Viele der heute in Gefangenschaft lebenden Delfine wurden vor Jahrzehnten aus dem Meer entrissen und von ihren Familien getrennt. Andere wurden bereits in Gefangenschaft geboren und konnten nie frei im offenen Ozean schwimmen. 


Panettiere macht in dem Video deutlich, welche Folgen diese Gefangenschaft für die Tiere haben kann, und fordert die Öffentlichkeit dazu auf, keine Meeresparks mit Delfinhaltung zu besuchen. 


Vow today to never go to a marine park that keeps dolphins in extreme captivity. Together, we can end this cruelty.

Hayden Panettiere


Sie ruft dazu auf, keine Meeresparks zu besuchen, die Delfine unter solch grausamen Bedingungen gefangen halten, und diese Tierquälerei gemeinsam zu beenden. 


Hayden Panettieres langjähriger Einsatz für Delfine 


Die Kampagne war nicht Panettieres erster Einsatz für Delfine und andere Meeressäuger. Bereits 2007 paddelte die damals 18-Jährige vor 

Taiji in Japan

 ins Wasser und stellte sich Delfinjäger:innen entgegen. Die Ereignisse rund um die dortige Delfinjagd wurden später auch im Oscar-prämierten Dokumentarfilm 

The Cove

 thematisiert. 


2015 unterstützte Panettiere zudem eine juristische Stellungnahme gegen die geplante Einfuhr von 18 wild gefangenen Belugas aus Russland durch das Georgia Aquarium. 


2019 appellierte sie an den russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin, fast 100 Belugas und 

Orcas

 freizulassen, die für die Haltung in Meeresparks vorgesehen waren. Die Tiere wurden anschließend ins Meer zurückgebracht; Russland untersagte im selben Jahr ihre entsprechende Gefangennahme. 


Auch für andere Tiere setzte sich Panettiere ein 


Panettieres Engagement beschränkte sich nicht auf Meeressäuger. Während der Dreharbeiten zur Serie 

Heroes

 ließ sie beispielsweise die Arbeiten unterbrechen, um Vögel zu schützen, die von einem Crewmitglied mit einem Laubbläser vertrieben wurden. 


Gemeinsam mit unseren internationalen Partnerorganisationen erinnern wir von PETA Deutschland durch die Veröffentlichung ihrer letzten Kampagne an Panettieres langjährigen Einsatz für Tiere. Hayden Panettiere starb wenige Wochen

 

nach den Aufnahmen für die Kampagne. Sie richtete sich dabei an alle Menschen, die Delfine schützen möchten: Unterstützen Sie keine Einrichtungen, die die Tiere zu

author: hsa_oryx
title: COVERDALE SHOOT STOPPED BY SABS ON THE INGLORIOUS TWELFTH
content:
The HSA has continually

shared footage and information

 exposing the destruction and cruelty caused by the shooting industry. The extent of the persecution knows no bounds with badgers, foxes, corvids and all manner of wildlife being killed as the land is stripped of any natural balance just to appease those in tweed.


Snare found on the Walshaw Estate, West Yorkshire, January 2024.


So, as is customary, on the 12th of August, coined the ‘glorious twelfth’ by shooters, sabs joined forces to stop them and save lives.


Upon entering the Yorkshire Dales, it quickly became apparent that North Yorkshire police were ready and waiting to try and delay and prevent sabs from achieving their mission. Sab vehicles were pulled over, and dispersal orders were quickly scribbled out, but sabs are not easily deterred and great teamwork and communication meant that some groups made it onto the moors where they prevented the Coverdale shoot from a day’s killing.


North Yorkshire police enabling the slaughtering of Grouse.


In frustration their main transport vehicle drove at sabs while the police were present, drawing attention to the fact that their vehicle had no tax, leaving the tweed clad sour faces to walk to a nearby farm to await collection.


Sabs congregated on the moors to prevent the Coverdale shoot from a day’s killing.

© Newcastle Hunt Sabs


As well as witnessing the sheer lengths the police will go to to protect this blood sport it was also glaringly apparent the extent of damage being done to the moors for this high money business.


The entire ecology of the moors has been altered to accommodate this industry with desolate and barren views stretching far and wide and with the UK reaching record high temperatures over the past few years, wildfires are becoming more common as the intensive management of grouse moors creates the perfect conditions for it to spread.


Shoots burn heather on the moors resulting in a reduction in biodiversity and the release of stored carbon dioxide.


Without a doubt shooting isn’t just a blood sport, it is extremely detrimental to the environment, and the HSA will continue to expose it.

title: Ankara/Çayırhan: Maden göçtü: 1 ölüm 19 yaralanma bildirildi
content:
Ankara'nın Beypazarı ilçesine bağlı Hırkatepe Mahallesi'ndeki Çayırhan Enerji İşletmesi sahasında cuma günü saat 18.00 sıralarında maden kazası meydana geldi.


Ankara Valiliği'nin açıklamasına göre, "ilk tespitlerde çalışma sahasının arkasındaki tavanın çökmesi sonucu oluşan basınç" işçilerin savrulmasına yol açtı.


Kazada madenci Erdi Kahveci öldü. Valilik olaydan toplam 20 kişinin etkilendiğini, yaralanan 19 işçinin hastanelerde tedavi altına alındığını bildirdi.


Olay yerine jandarma, emniyet, itfaiye, AFAD, UMKE ve sağlık ekipleri sevk edildi. Yaralıların hastanelere taşınması için 15 ambulans görevlendirildi.


İlk saatlerde haber ajanslarına yansıyan yaralı sayısı önce 8, ardından 12 olarak açıklanmıştı. Ankara Valiliği'nin daha sonra yaptığı açıklamayla bilanço 1 ölü, 19 yaralı olarak güncellendi.


Valilik kazanın ardından gerekli inceleme ve soruşturmanın başlatıldığını açıkladı.


YENİ Parti'li Murat Emir: “İş cinayetleri kader değildir”


YENİ Parti Grup Başkanvekili Murat Emir, Ankara’nın Nallıhan ilçesindeki Çayırhan Kömür İşletmeleri’nde meydana gelen bir işçinin hayatını kaybettiği maden kazasına ilişkin sosyal medya hesabından açıklama yaptı: 


“Ankara Nallıhan'daki Çayırhan Kömür İşletmeleri'nde meydana gelen maden göçüğünde bir emekçinin hayatını kaybettiğini ve 12 emekçinin yaralandığını derin bir üzüntüyle öğrendim. Hayatını kaybeden madencimize Allah’tan rahmet, acılı ailesine sabır; yaralılarımıza acil şifalar diliyorum. İş cinayetleri kader değildir”


Dört işçinin durumunun ağır olduğu bildirildi


Ankara Valisi Yakup Canpolat, Sözcü TV'ye yaptığı ilk açıklamada yaralılardan dördünün durumunun ağır olduğunu bildirdi.


İlk haberlerde yaralı işçilerin Beypazarı Devlet Hastanesi'ne kaldırıldığı belirtildi. Yaralıların sağlık durumlarına ve ağır yaralıların hangi hastanelerde tedavi edildiğine ilişkin ayrıntılı resmi açıklama henüz yapılmadı.


Kazanın kesin nedeni, çökmenin meydana geldiği galerideki çalışma koşulları ve iş sağlığı ve güvenliği önlemlerine ilişkin, henüz yetkili ya da uzman kuruluşlardan bir açıklama yapılmadı.
