title: Five children injured in landmine explosion in Til Temir
content:
The five children, who were herding sheep in the area around the village of Til Hemam, west of Til Temir, were injured in the landmine explosion.


The injured children were taken to Habur Hospital in Til Temir, where they received emergency treatment. The two seriously injured children, Îbrahîm Ebducasim (17) and Muhamed Xelef (12), were transferred to hospitals in Hesekê.


Ebdurehman Mehmûd (14) sustained an injury to his right foot; Ûsama Hesen Seqir (13) was injured in his right knee and abdomen; and Leys Eseed Şihaze (10) sustained an injury to his right foot.

author: Jake Johnson
title: Israeli Settlers Have Displaced 107 Palestinian West Bank Communities Since 2023
content:
A new report by Human Rights Watch details how the Israeli government has directly facilitated displacement.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Intensifying violence by government-backed Israeli settlers in the illegally occupied West Bank is fueling the mass displacement and erasure of entire Palestinian communities, according to a report published Thursday by Human Rights Watch.

HRW pointed with alarm to United Nations data showing that the average number of settler attacks per day in the West Bank has risen to the highest level on record as the far-right Israeli government, led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, continues to expand settlements in open defiance of international law.

The leading human rights group’s new report estimates that Israeli settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank has “fully or partially displaced 107 communities,” comprised of nearly 6,000 Palestinians, since January 2023. The escalating displacement in the West Bank comes amid Israel’s ongoing genocidal assault on the Gaza Strip.

“The Israeli government and the settlers share the same goal of maximum land and minimum Palestinians, with the authorities not only failing to stop settler violence, but actively enabling it,” Sarah Sanbar, acting Israel and Palestine researcher at HRW, said in a statement. “Settlers shoot, attack, and expel Palestinians from their land, and the state provides the weapons, the legal cover, and the budget to do it.”

HRW’s report was released days after the Israeli government published a new tender for the construction of more than 1,200 housing units in the West Bank. The anti-occupation group Peace Now noted that the bidding period for companies to build the units closes a week before Israel’s elections.

“Building in E1 will ruin the possibility of reaching an end to the conflict and a peace arrangement based on two states,” said Peace Now. “The government is trying to sign contracts with contractors before the elections so that it will be much harder for the next government to cancel the construction.”

HRW warned that companies seeking a role in constructing the new housing units are “bidding on complicity in a war crime.”

For its report on settler violence, HRW interviewed 20 witnesses and reviewed video footage of attacks, which have included physical assaults, sexual violence, property destruction, theft, and killings — often carried out alongside Israeli soldiers. HRW noted that Israel’s National Security Ministry has “formed civilian ‘rapid response squads’ in settlements” and given them “special policing powers, uniforms, and weapons.”

“I have known war in this region for all my life, but never like this,” said Um Muhammad Muammar, a 72-year-old resident of Qaryut whose two sons were killed by Israeli settlers. “My sons’ children are now fatherless; their wives are now widows. What more can we say?”

With the support of Israel’s government, settlers have established 65 new outposts in the West Bank this year alone. “Israeli organizations Kerem Navot and PeaceNow reported in July that these outposts currently effectively control more than 1 million dunams (100,000 hectares) of land — approximately 18% of the West Bank — four times what they controlled before the current government took office,” HRW observed.

“The impunity Israeli authorities accord settlers stems directly from the free pass Israel’s allies and donors have granted it,” said Sanbar. “Accountability starts with the settlers committing crimes but doesn’t end there. Israel and the governments that give it a blank check share responsibility and should be held to account.”

content:
For the English version of this story, please see

Community mourns 4-year-old Ivujivik boy as family seeks answers

.


ᐃᕗᔾᔨᕕᖕᒥᐅᑦ ᑲᑎᓚᐅᖅᐳᑦ ᐋᒍᔅᑎ 13−ᒥ ᐃᓗᐃᓪᓚᕿᑎᓪᓗᒋᑦ ᑎᓴᒪᓂᒃ-ᐅᑭᐅᓕᒃ ᔫᓯ ᐳᓪᓚᔮᑦᒥᑦ ᐃᓚᖏᑦ ᕿᓂᖅᑎᓪᓗᒋᑦ ᑭᐅᔾᔪᑎᓂᑦ ᐃᓅᓕᓴᖅᑕᐅᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐸᖅᑭᔭᐅᓂᖓᓂ ᐱᓚᐅᖅᑕᖓᓂ ᑐᖁᓚᐅᙱᓐᓂᖓᓂ.


ᐳᓪᓚᔮᑦ ᐃᓗᕕᖅᓯᐅᖅᑕᐅᓂᖓ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᑕᐅᓯᒪᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ 1 ᐅᓐᓄᓴᒃᑯᑦ, ᐊᓈᓇᑦᑎᐊᖓ, ᐋᓂ ᒪᖏᐅᖅ, ᐅᖃᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᓄᓇᓖᑦ ᕙᐃᔅᐳᒃᑯᑦ ᑲᑎᙵᓂᐅᔪᒥ.


ᒪᖏᐅᖅ ᓴᖅᑭᑎᑦᑎᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᐃᓱᒫᓘᑕᐅᔪᓂ ᐃᕐᙳᑕᖓᑕ ᖃᓄᐃᓐᓂᖓᓂ ᑎᑎᕋᕐᓂᐅᔪᓂ ᓄᓇᓖᑦ ᕙᐃᔅᐳᒃᑯᑦ ᑲᑎᙵᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᑐᑯᕝᖁᓚᐅᙱᑎᓪᓗᒍ.


ᔪᓚᐃ 31−ᒥ ᑎᑎᕋᕐᓂᐅᔪᒥ, ᐅᖃᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᓄᑲᑉᐱᐊᖅ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᖏᓐᓇᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᓈᖓᓂᐅᔪᒥ, ᓂᕆᓚᐅᑦᑎᐊᕐᓇᓂ ᐱᓇᓱᐊᕈᓯᐅᑉ ᐅᖓᑖᓄᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐃᓚᒌᑦ ᕿᓃᓐᓇᓚᐅᖅᐳᑦ ᐃᓅᓕᓴᖅᑕᐅᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑕᐅᔪᒪᓂᕐᒧᑦ.


ᐅᖃᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᐃᓗᐊᖅᓴᐃᔨᖏᑦ ᐅᖃᐅᔾᔨᓚᐅᖅᐳᑦ ᐃᓚᒌᖑᔪᓂ ᑐᓂᔭᐅᖁᔭᐅᓪᓗᓂ ᓂᐊᖁᖅᓯᐅᑎᓂ ᐋᑦᕕᐅᓪᒥ ᐊᒻᒪ ᑕᐃᓕᓈᓪᒥ ᐊᒻᒪ ᓈᒻᒪᒃᑐᒥ ᖃᐅᔨᓴᖅᑕᐅᑦᑎᐊᓚᐅᙱᓚᖅ ᐃᓱᒪᒋᓇᒍ ᐃᓱᒫᓘᑎᒋᔭᐅᔪᓂ.


ᓄᓇᑦᓯᐊᖅ ᑐᓴᒐᒃᓴᓕᕆᔨᒃᑯᑦ ᖃᔅᓯᒐᓚᒃᑎᒍᑦ ᖃᐅᔨᒋᐊᕋᓱᓚᐅᖅᐳᑦ ᐃᓚᒋᔭᐅᔪᓂ ᑭᓯᐊᓂ ᐱᓚᐅᙱᓚᑦ ᑭᐅᔭᐅᓂᐅᔪᒥ.


ᓄᓇᕕᖕᒥ ᐸᓖᓯᒃᑯᑦ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᖅᑏᑦ ᓇᓗᓇᐃᖅᓯᓚᐅᖅᐳᑦ ᖃᕋᓴᐅᔭᑎᒍᑦ ᑎᑎᕋᕐᓂᐅᔪᒃᑯᑦ ᓄᓇᑦᓯᐊᖅ ᑐᓴᒐᒃᓴᓕᕆᔨᕐᖁᓐᓄᑦ ᐸᓖᓰᑦ ᑭᐅᓚᐅᕐᓂᖏᓐᓂ ᐋᒍᔅᑎ 1−ᒥ ᐃᓅᓕᓴᖅᑕᐅᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑕᐅᔪᒪᓂᐅᔪᒧᑦ ᐅᖃᓗᖕᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᐱᔾᔪᑎᓕᖕᒥ ᖃᐅᔨᒪᙱᑦᑐᒥ ᑎᓴᒪᓂ-ᐅᑭᐅᓕᖕᒧᑦ ᐊᖏᕐᕋᕆᔭᐅᔪᒥ ᐃᕗᔾᔨᕕᖕᒥ.


ᑐᐊᕕᕐᓇᖅᑐᒥ ᐃᓅᓕᓴᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᖅᑎᒃᑯᓐᓂ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᖅᑎᓂ ᐅᓯᑲᑦᑕᓚᐅᖅᐳᑦ ᓱᕈᓯᕐᒥ ᐃᓅᓕᑦᓯᕕᒃ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᕕᒃ ᐸᓖᓯᒃᑯᑦ ᑭᐅᖕᒪᑕ, ᐊᖓᔪᖅᑳᑉ ᑐᖓᓕᐊ ᓵᓐ ᓛᖕᓯᑐᕇᑦ ᐅᖃᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ.


ᐅᖃᐅᓯᐅᓪᓗᓂ ᐃᓅᓕᑦᓯᕕᒃ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᕕᒃ ᐃᑭᐊᖅᑭᕕᖓᓂ, ᐃᕗᔾᔨᕕᒃ ᐊᑕᐅᓯᕐᒥ ᐊᖓᔪᖅᑳᖑᔪᒥ ᐃᓗᐊᖅᓴᐃᔨᖃᖅᐳᖅ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐊᑕᐅᓯᕐᒥ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᕕᖕᒥ ᐃᓗᐊᖅᓴᐃᔨᖃᖅᐳᑦ ᑕᐃᑲᓂ.


ᑭᖑᓂᐊᒍᑦ ᑎᑎᕋᕐᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᐋᒍᔅᑎ 9−ᒥ, ᒪᖏᐅᖅ ᐅᖃᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᔫᓯ ᑐᖁᓚᐅᕐᓂᖓᓂ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐸᓯᒃᖠᖅᖢᓂ ᐃᓗᐊᖅᓴᐃᔩᑦ ᐃᕗᔾᔨᕕᖕᒥ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐳᕕᖕᓂᖅᑑᒥ ᐅᒃᐱᕈᓱᓚᐅᙱᓐᓂᖏᓐᓂ ᐱᕐᔪᐊᖑᓂᖓᓂ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᕐᓂᖓᓂ.


ᑕᐃᒃᑯᐊ ᐃᓱᒫᓘᑕᐅᔪᑦ ᑎᑭᐅᑎᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᐅᓄᕐᓂᖅᓴᓄᑦ ᐅᖃᓕᒫᖅᑎᓄᑦ ᑲᑕᔾᔭᖅᑎ ᓰᓇ ᓄᕗᓕᙵ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᖃᕐᒪᑦ ᑎᑎᕋᖅᑕᖓᓂ ᐳᓪᓚᔮᑦ ᑐᖁᓂᖓᓂ, ᐃᓚᖃᖅᑐᒥ GoFundMe ᑮᓇᐅᔭᓂ ᐱᕈᖅᓴᐃᓇᓱᐊᕐᓂᖓᓂ ᐃᓚᖏᓐᓄᑦ.


ᐃᓅᖃᑎᒌᖕᓄᑦ ᓯᐊᒻᒪᖅᑎᑦᑎᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᑎᑎᕋᖅᑕᖓ ᐱᒋᐊᖅᑎᑦᑎᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᐅᖓᓯᒃᑐᒥᙶᖅᑐᓂ ᐃᒃᐱᒍᓱᖕᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᕿᒃᓵᖕᓇᖅᑐᒃᑰᖅᑎᓪᓗᒋᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᓄᑖᙳᕆᐊᖅᑐᒥ ᐅᖃᓪᓚᖕᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᐊᑐᐃᓐᓇᖃᕐᓂᕐᒥ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᖃᕐᓇᙱᑦᑐᓕᕆᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐸᖅᑭᔭᐅᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᓄᓇᖃᖅᑳᖅᓯᒪᔪᓄᑦ ᓄᓇᓕᐅᔪᓄᑦ.


ᒐᕙᒪᑐᖃᒃᑯᑦ ᓄᓇᖃᖅᑳᖅᓯᒪᔪᓄᑦ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᒥᓂᔅᑕᖓ ᒫᓐᑎ ᒑᓪ− ᒫᔅᑎ, ᓕᐳᕈᒃᑯᑦ ᑲᓇᑕᐅᑉ ᒪᓕᒐᓕᐅᖅᑎᖏᓐᓂ ᐃᓚᒋᔭᐅᔪᖅ ᐊᐱᑎᐱ—ᓯᕿᓂᕐᒥᐅᑦ—ᓄᓇᕕᒃ—ᐄᔭᐅ, ᑐᓂᓯᓚᐅᖅᐳᑦ ᐃᒃᐱᒍᓱᖕᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᕿᒃᓵᖕᓇᖅᑐᒃᑰᖅᑎᓪᓗᒋᑦ ᐋᒍᔅᑎ 12−ᒥ ᐳᓪᓚᔮᑦ ᐃᓚᖏᓐᓄᑦ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᒃᓴᓕᐅᕐᓂᒃᑯᑦ ᕙᐃᔅᐳᒃᑯᑦ.


“ᐆᒻᒪᑎᒃᑯᑦ ᐋᓐᓂᕐᓇᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᑐᓴᕐᓂᕐᒥ ᐃᓅᔪᓐᓃᕐᓂᖓᓂ ᑎᓴᒪᓂ−ᐅᑭᐅᓕᖕᒥ ᓄᑲᑉᐱᐊᕐᒥ ᐃᕗᔾᔨᕕᖕᒥ, ᓂᕈᐊᖅᑕᐅᕝᕕᒋᔭᓐᓂ,” ᒑᓪ-ᒫᔅᑎ ᐅᖃᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ.


“ᓂᕆᐅᒃᐳᒍᑦ ᑲᓇᑕᒥ ᐊᕕᒃᑐᖅᓯᒪᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᑯᐸᐃᖕᒥ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐃᓅᓕᓴᐃᓂᕐᒥ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᖅᑎᓂ ᐃᓚᐅᔪᓂ ᑭᐅᓂᖓᓂ ᐆᒥᖓ ᐱᓕᕆᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᐱᓪᓚᕆᐅᓂᖅᐹᖑᔪᒥ ᐊᒻᒪᓗ ᓇᓗᓇᐃᖅᓯᓂᕐᒥ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᓯᐅᔪᖅ ᑐᓂᓯᔪᓐᓇᕐᓂᐊᕐᓂᖓᓂ ᑭᐅᔾᔪᑎᓂ ᐃᓚᖏᓐᓄᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᓄᓇᓕᖕᓄᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᓗᑎᒡᓗ ᐱᑎᑦᑎᑦᑕᐃᓕᒪᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᓯᕗᓂᒃᓴᒥ ᐱᓂᕐᓗᒡᔪᐊᕐᓂᐅᔪᓂ ᑕᐃᒪᐃᒃᑲᓐᓂᕐᓂᖓᓂ.”


ᐃᓅᓕᑦᓯᕕᒃ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᕕᒃ ᐊᒻᒪ ᓄᓇᕕᖕᒥ ᐊᕕᒃᑐᖅᓯᒪᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᑲᑎᒪᔨᓄᑦ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᖃᕐᓇᙱᑦᑐᓕᕆᔨᒃᑯᓐᓂ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐃᓄᓕᕆᔨᒃᑯᓐᓂ ᑐᓂᓯᓚᐅᖅᐳᑦ ᑲᑐᔾᔨᓪᓗᑎᒃ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᒃᓴᓕᐊᖑᔪᒥ ᐋᒍᔅᑎ 12−ᒥ, ᐅᖃᐅᓯᖃᖅᖢᑎᒃ ᖃᔅᓯᒐᓚᖕᓂ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᔭᐅᓂᐅᔪᓂ ᐱᒋᐊᖅᑎᑕᐅᓯᒪᕗᑦ ᖃᓄᐃᓐᓂᐅᔪᓂ ᓱᕈᓯᐅᑉ ᑐᖁᓂᖓᓄᑦ.


ᐋᓐᓂᐊᕕᐅᑉ ᐃᓅᓕᓴᕐᕕᖕᒥ ᑐᑭᒧᐊᒃᑎᑦᑎᔨᖏᑦ ᐱᒋᐊᖅᓯᒪᕗᑦ ᐊᔾᔨᒌᙱᑦᑐᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᖃᕐᓂᕐᒥ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᔭᐅᓂᖓᓂ. ᑐᖁᖓᔪᓕᕆᔨ ᐱᒋᐊᖅᑎᑦᑎᓯᒪᑎᓪᓗᒍ ᖃᐅᔨᓴᖅᑕᐅᓂᐅᔪᒥ, ᐅᖃᐅᓯᒃᓴᓕᐊᖅ ᐅᖃᖅᓯᒪᕗᖅ.


ᑐᖁᖓᔪᓕᕆᔨᐅᑉ ᖃᐅᔨᓴᖅᑕᐅᓂᖓ, ᐱᓕᕆᐊᖑᓲᖑᔪᒥ ᑐᖁᔪᖃᕌᖓᑦ ᐅᕘᓇ ᐋᓐᓂᖅᓯᕆᕐᔪᐊᕐᓂᐅᔪᒥ, ᑐᑭᓯᓇᙱᑦᑐᒥ ᐅᕝᕙᓘᓐᓃᑦ ᑲᒪᑦᑎᐊᙱᑦᑐᒥ ᖃᓄᐃᓐᓂᐅᔪᓂ, ᐱᓕᕆᐊᖑᓲᖑᕗᖅ ᑕᖅᑭᓂᑦ 6−ᓂ 12−ᓄᑦ, ᐅᖃᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᑯᐸᐃᖕᒥ ᑐᖁᖓᔪᓕᕆᔨᒧᑦ ᑎᑎᕋᕐᕕᖓᓂ ᐅᖃᖅᑎᐅᔪᒥ ᔭᐃᒃ ᓚᒧᑕ ᒍᕋᓈᑐ ᖃᕋᓴᐅᔭᑎᒍᑦ ᑎᑎᕋᕐᓂᐅᔪᒥ.


ᐋᓐᓂᐊᖃᕐᓇᙱᑦᑐᓕᕆᔨᒃᑯᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐃᓄᓕᕆᔨᒃᑯᑦ ᑲᑎᒪᔨᖏᑕ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐱᐅᓂᖓᓂ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐅᖃᐱᓘᑕᐅᔪᓂ ᑲᒥᓴᓇᖓ ᐃᓚᐅᖃᑕᐅᒋᕗᖅ, ᐊᒻᒪ ᐃᒻᒥᒃᑰᖅᑐᒥ ᐃᓅᓕᓴᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᖃᐅᔨᓴᖅᑎᐅᔪᒥ ᓯᓚᑖᓂ ᐃᓅᓕᑦᓯᕕᒃ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᕕᖓᓂ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᓂᐊᖅᐳᑦ ᖃᓄᐃᓐᓂᐅᔪᒥ.


Québec solidaire, ᑲᓇᑕᐅᑉ ᐊᕕᒃᑐᖅᓯᒪᓂᖓᓂ ᑲᑎᒪᔨᕐᔪᐊᓄᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᒋᔭᐅᓂᐅᔪᓂ ᑲᑎᒪᔨᕐᔪᐊᖑᔪᓂ, ᖃᐃᖁᔨᓂᖃᖅᐳᖅ ᑯᐸᐃᖕᒥ ᓱᕈᓯᓄᑦ ᐱᔪᓐᓇᕐᓂᕆᔭᖏᓐᓂ ᐊᒻᒪ ᖃᓄᐃᙱᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᑲᒥᓴᓇᖓᓂ ᖃᐅᔨᓴᕐᓂᖓᓂ ᒨᓯᐅᑉ ᑐᖁᓂᖓᓂ.


“ᐅᓇ, ᓱᓕᒃᑲᓐᓂᖅ, ᐱᓕᕆᓂᐅᒍᓂ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᓯᒥᒃ ᖃᓄᐃᑦᑑᓂᖏᑦ ᐱᔾᔪᑎᒋᓪᓗᒋᑦ ᐊᑭᕋᖅᑐᐃᓂᐅᒍᓂ ᐋᓐᓂᐊᖃᕐᓇᙱᑦᑐᓕᕆᓂᕐᒥ−ᐸᖅᑭᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᓯᐅᔪᒥ, ᑐᑭᓯᓇᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᒥ ᓇᓗᓇᐃᖅᑕᐅᔭᕆᐊᖃᖅᐳᖅ ᐊᒻᒪ ᒪᓕᒃᑐᒥ ᖃᓄᐃᓕᐅᕐᓂᐅᔪᒥ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᖑᔪᒥ,” ᑲᑎᒪᔨᕐᔪᐊᑦ ᐅᖃᖅᑎᖓ ᓲᓪ ᓴᓇᑎ ᐅᖃᓚᐅᖅᐳᖅ ᐋᒍᔅᑎ 13−ᒥ ᐅᐃᕖᑎᑐᑦ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᒃᓴᓕᐊᖑᔪᒥ.

author: Unknown
title: I see you replacing remembrance of ancestors for reverence, inserting a hierarchy that wasn’t there
content:
I’m starting to think all humans are fundamentally spiritual, and just like every other human need, if you repress it, it’ll just express itself covertly in fucked up ways

You have a human need to process the world through narrative, to share meaning with community, to have a path to redemption, to ritualize your uncertainties, to connect with inanimate objects

If you cross your arms and deny yourself this expression, all of those psychological needs will get funneled into a spirituality most unpleasant, like conspiracy rabbit holes and unhealthy obsessions with fandom

If you care about your morality, then you should care how your spiritual needs manifest and ensure they’re being met and fulfilled, lest you become one of those people willing to crusade for your discord mod

Being a leftist queer doesn’t isolate you from this, you’re not immune from latent cultural Christianity (I say as a leftist queer)

Intentionally design your spirituality!

Or just use skepticism and critical thinking skills? I guess it depends how you define spirituality but if that involves “believing in things they aren’t real” then Jo, that’s not a necessary human experience. The fuck makes you think we need a path to redemption? Redemption from what? And toughest purpose?

Sure but by that same token human beings can’t live life in an entirely scientifically functional way. I do still get flutters in my chest when I look up at the sunlight through the bottom of a treetop, and I think letting yourself get swept up in that with a little bit of philosophical wish-washing is good for you

Again how do we define spirituality here? Is it just having rituals or does it require belief in unreal things? We need to be clear on terms here to begin with. Does having a fandom count? Just having moral principals we stick to? Is it compatible with a rationalist and materialist worldview?

I mean “unreal” perhaps in the sense that our emotions and reactions cannot be perfectly scientifically explained.

You can’t be unflinchingly rational about all things at all times, sounds like an awful boring way to love. Gotta have some whimsy and wonder someplace

Why do you assume whimsey and wonder are mutually exclusive to rationality? Wonder is what leads to research and further understanding.

You still seem to be affected by the cultural stereotype of a joyless atheist.

I *am* an atheist, I just choose not to be entirely, perfectly rational all the time

Atheists can still be affected by cultural Christianity, including internal used atheist stereotypes.

I fully admit to taking irrational actions such as my fear of wasps but I still recognize these as irrational.

I try to view the world as rationally as I’m able, knowing that my phobia is an irrational fear response caused by chemical reactions in the brain doesn’t “ruin the whimsey” or whatever.

Sure but you still have to let yourself FEEL things without explaining them away right? I know that my wonder is a chemical reaction but that’s not what I’m thinking about as it’s happening

Why do you believe explaining something somehow ruins it? Also to get back to the original discussion, are we considering “having emotions” as the same as spirituality?

Your internal experience is rational. There is no such thing as an “irrational emotion.”

Emotions are our baseline way of processing the world around us, and they happen regardless of whether or not that emotion is proportional or makes sense to an outside viewer. Therapists say “your feelings are valid” because they literally are, and that includes even the more pernicious emotions. Saying an emotion is irrational is like saying the way your eyes filter through light is irrational. Emotions aren’t bound to rationality.

That doesn’t mean every single emotion will be pleasant or healthy, but they do have to be acknowledged and honored. Your fear of bugs should be honored. Your awe at sunlight through treetops should be honored. Those things don’t require a relationship to reason and logic because they’re not involved in the brain’s higher reasoning. Emotions and fears are not actions.

Further, we can act rationally on an unverified worldview. We can be acting rationally and choosing to engage with spirituality for our personal well-being. Just as an example, it’s rational to ward and protect your house if you believe it can be negatively influenced by spirits. You can say believing in spirits is irrational, but belief actually makes up a surprisingly …

author: Rizomatica
title: Comunicados del Centro de  Estudiantes y la Dirección del Liceo Rayen Mapu, frente a procedimiento policial al interior del establecimiento que obligó a estudiantes a desnudarse frente a sus compañeros
content:
«COMUNICADO DEL CENTRO DE ESTUDIANTES


Sobre situación ocurrida con estudiantes de 2° medio.


Como Centro de Estudiantes del Liceo Rayen Mapu, queremos informar a nuestra comunidad educativa sobre una situación que nos fue comunicada por estudiantes de 2′ medio y que consideramos de especial gravedad.


De acuerdo con el relato entregado por nuestros compañeros y compañeras, durante una jornada de clases se produjo la pérdida de un teléfono celular perteneciente a una estudiante del curso. A partir de esta situación, dos estudiantes fueron señalados como principales sospechosos, sin que, según lo informado por ellos, se les hubiera comunicado la existencia de antecedentes concretos que justificaran dicha acusación.


La situación adquiere especial preocupación porque, según el relato recibido, fue la docente a cargo de la clase quien identificó a estos estudiantes como sospechosos y posteriormente solicitó la presencia de Carabineros en el establecimiento.


Antes de realizar una investigación que permitiera establecer qué había ocurrido realmente,cuatro estudiantes habrían sido retenidos y se les habría impedido salir al recreo.


Como Centro de Estudiantes, consideramos necesario cuestionar esta actuación, ya que una sospecha no puede transformarse automáticamente en una acusación ni justificar que determinados estudiantes sean tratadoscomo responsables de un hecho que aún no ha sido esclarecido.


Posteriormente, una vez que los estudiantes se encontraban nuevamente en la sala, funcionarios de Carabineros habrían realizado un procedimiento dirigido solamente a dos de ellos, frente al resto de sus compañeros y compañieras.


La situación que más nos preocupa corresponde al procedimiento realizado sobre los estudiantes. Según lo informado, a uno de ellos se le habría solicitado quitarse el polerón y las zapatillas y, además, se le habría levantado la polera frente a sus compañeros. Al segundo estudiante se le habría solicitado quitarse pantalones, polerón, polera y zapatillas, para posteriormente realizar sentadillas frente a sus compañeros, funcionarios policiales y funcionarias del establecimiento presentes en ese momento.


Como Centro de Estudiantes, condenamos tanto la exposición de los estudiantes como cualquier actuación previa que haya contribuido a que fueran individualizados y sometidos a este procedimiento sin que existiera una investigación que determinara su responsabilidad.


Queremos ser claros: la pérdida o eventual hurto de un objeto debe ser investigado y, si corresponde, denunciado ante las autoridades competentes. Sin embargo, la responsabilidad de un estudiante no puede darse por establecida simplemente por una sospecha. Todo estudiante tiene derecho a ser tratado con respeto y a que se respete su dignidad mientras los hechos son investigados.


La legislación chilena protege la integridad fisica y psíquica, la vida privada y la honra de las personas. Estos derechos tienen especial relevancia cuando se trata de niños, niñas y adolescentes.La Ley N° 21.430, sobre Garantías y Protección Integral de los Derechos de la Niñez y Adolescencia, establece la protección frente a injerencias arbitrarias en la vida privada y reconoce el derecho de niños, niñas yadolescentes a ser escuchados en los asuntos que les afectan. Estos principios también están reconocidos por la Convención sobre los Derechos del Niño.


Por lo tanto, consideramos necesario que se investigue no solamente el procedimiento realizado posteriormente, sino también la forma en que se originó esta situación, incluyendo la decisión de individualizar a determinados estudiantes como sospechosos y solicitar la intervención policial.


Como representantes estudiantiles, solicitamos:


Que se investigue formalmente todo lo ocurrido, desde el momento en que se informó la pérdida del celular hasta el procedimiento realizado posteriormente.


Que se determine qué antecedentes existían para señalar especificamente a determinados estudiantes como sospechosos.


Que se revise si la actuación de la docente y de los demás adultos presentes se ajustó a sus deberes y a los protocolos del establecimiento.


Que se determine si el procedimiento policial se realizó conforme a la legislación vigente.Que se resguarde la dignidad, integridad fisica y psíquica, honra y privacidad de los estudiantesinvolucrados.


Que los estudiantes afectados sean escuchados y puedan entregar su versión de los hechos.


Que se adopten medidas para evitar que una situación …

author: David Bacon
title: Union-Busters Are Using ICE to Intimidate California Wine Industry Workers
content:
California’s wine industry runs on immigrant exploitation. Now migrant workers are unionizing.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

In late July, Raul Calvo, a well-known California union-buster, called workers at the Rodney Strong Vineyards into a meeting. Salvador Ramirez, who’d labored among big wine tanks for 12 years, says he was shocked by what he heard. “He said he was just going to give us the information that he got in an email three days ago, that ICE [Immigration and Customs Enforcement] was here outside,” Ramirez remembers, noting that Calvo told workers the vineyard was technically in a border zone due to its proximity to the ocean.

Ramirez says workers were very upset — not just by Calvo’s implied threat, but because the company’s attitude had changed drastically. Last October, when there were rumors that ICE agents planned a wave of raids in the San Francisco Bay Area like those underway in Los Angeles, the company had called everyone into a meeting. Ramirez recalled, “‘You’re our workers,’ they told us. ‘We have to support you and we’re not going to allow them to come in [without a judge’s warrant]. We’re going to take care of each other.’“

Calvo did not respond to Truthout’s request for comment.

In the months afterwards, however, workers began talking with each other. They then reached out to North Bay Jobs with Justice (JwJ), a coalition of community organizations and unions in Sonoma and Napa Counties with a long history of fighting for workers’ rights. North Bay JwJ helped them organize a workplace committee, and put them in touch with Teamsters Local 665, a union with representatives on the organization’s board.

Ramirez and 31 of the winery’s 50 workers signed a petition asking that the company agree to a card check process for recognizing the union they’d formed, and for a “fair process to exercise our right to organize and form a union without threats and intimidation.” At the beginning of June, they took it to management. Rafael Malfavon, whom the workers call “Junior,” presented it and asked the company to accept their decision. Community leaders — including Chris Herrod, the mayor of Healdsburg — went along to support them.

The company’s response was to hire a local union-buster, Jesse Rojas, who held two meetings with workers. Then Calvo, Rojas’s boss, showed up. When he challenged Calvo in a meeting over misstatements about unions, Malfavon says he was ridiculed. “That just proved to us that the company won’t listen to what workers are saying and what we’re asking for, and hired this dude who calls me a liar,” he said.

Workers formed a delegation and went to Becky Oseguera, the company’s human relations director. According to Ramirez, “One of us said the company had brought in these people and they were trying to intimidate us with the migra, and that wasn’t right. I said, ‘We believe this is a very serious line that’s been crossed.’ She told us, ‘Don’t you see that I’m very busy, with all this stuff that you’re doing?’”

Ramirez and his co-workers started organizing in part because the company was terminating longtime workers. “They started having meetings with us,” Malfavon recalled, “saying they had to cut their budget. No one would get bonuses like before. We noticed that we weren’t getting raises while we had to do extra work, and they wouldn’t hire people to help. But the executives were getting promotions.”

One fired worker was Belen Flores, who had banged her knee at work and was then let go by the company, citing a genetic vision problem as a pretext. “I could always do my job to the last day,” Flores said. “I never got even a warning.”

Ramirez was incensed. “She’d been working here for nine years, and they fired her just like that,” he said. “There were rumors that there are five more people on the list after Belen. I could see the future that awaits us.”

Malfavon said that when his brother was terminated, he asked the company for some explanation. “They didn’t want to answer any of my questions. I had no words. I literally sat in the corner and started crying. I felt so powerless.”

The terminations came on top of increasing economic pressure. Despite working at Rodney Strong while also holding another full-time job, Malfavon is still living at home with his parents. Two-thirds of the people working in the winery have second jobs, he says. Malfavon is …

author: Sophia Sheera
title: Israel Finally Admits Responsibility for Killing Five-Year-Old Hind Rajab
content:
The Israeli military has finally admitted to opening fire on the car carrying Hind Rajab.


Israel has long denied that any troops were present in the Tel-al-Hawa neighbourhood of Gaza City where the five-year-old and her family were killed on 29 January 2024.


But on Wednesday, the Israeli military announced that it would open a criminal investigation into both Rajab’s death and a separate incident in March 2025, in which Israeli troops killed 15 Palestinian medics and buried them in a mass grave.


Investigations by the Washington Post, Sky News and Forensic Architecture had already concluded that Rajab and six family members were fleeing Gaza when Israeli forces opened fire on their car. Israeli soldiers then shelled the ambulance dispatched to rescue Rajab, killing two medics.


The bodies of Rajab, her family and two Palestinian Red Cross paramedics were not recovered until 10 February 2023, when Israeli forces left the area. 


Rajab’s killing became one of the most reported crimes in the early months of the genocide in Gaza, after a recording of Rajab’s three-hour phone call to Palestinian paramedics was broadcast on global news networks. 


The story of Rajab’s death was later made into an Oscar-nominated film, The Voice of Hind Rajab, and cited in a

UN commission of inquiry accusing Israel of war crimes. 


The Hind Rajab Foundation, founded in 2024 to hold Israel accountable for war crimes in Gaza, said the Israeli investigation “should not be mistaken for a genuine step toward justice”.


“We do not trust the Israeli justice system, not out of an ideological position, but because of the track record,” said its director, Dyab Abou Jahjah. 


Only a “tiny percentage” of Israeli criminal investigations into the killing of Palestinians have produced convictions in the last decades, according to Dan Owen, a researcher at Israeli rights organisation Yesh Din.

author: Unknown
title: Iranian forces arrest three Kurdish men amid new crackdown
content:
As a new wave of arrests of Kurdish citizens continues, security forces have arrested three Kurdish men – Zaher Ghorbani, Shakhawan Khavari, and Farzin Khediripour – in Miandoab, Marivan, and Mahabad.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that Ministry of Intelligence forces raided Ghorbani’s family home in the village of Gavmish Goli in Miandoab County, West Azerbaijan Province, on 14 August, intending to arrest him.


As he was not there, the forces arrested his father, Loghman Ghorbani, and said he would not be released until his son reported to the Intelligence Ministry office in Miandoab.


Ghorbani reported to the office on 16 August and was arrested. His father was reportedly released afterwards.


On 17 August, security forces arrested Khavari at his family home in the village of Ney in Marivan County, Kurdistan Province.


The following day, Ministry of Intelligence forces arrested Khediripour at his workplace in Mahabad, West Azerbaijan Province.


The three men were arrested without warrants. At the time of writing, no information was available regarding the reasons for their arrests or the charges brought against them.


Despite repeated enquiries by their families about their status, the security and judicial authorities have continued to refuse to respond or provide any information.


According to figures compiled by KHRN, Ministry of Intelligence forces and the Intelligence Organisation of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) have arrested at least 29 Kurdish citizens in Bukan, Mahabad, Oshnavieh, Orumiyeh, Marivan, Sanandaj, Kamyaran and Piranshahr since 23 July.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Familias endeudadas, centrales sindicales y movimientos sociales marchan hoy al Ministerio de Economía
content:
Las centrales sindicales (CGT, ambas CTA), la UTEP y colectivos de familias damnificadas marchan hoy al Ministerio de Economía para protestar contra el fuerte crecimiento del sobreendeudamiento familiar y la morosidad récord en Argentina. La convocatoria es desde las 14hs en las esquinas de Paseo Colón e Independencia, y Paseo Colón y Estados Unidos (CABA). Las columnas avanzarán hacia el Palacio de Hacienda, ubicado en Hipólito Yrigoyen 250.


Según datos del Banco Central, la morosidad en hogares escaló al 12,7% en junio de 2026, afectando a cerca de 5,8 millones de personas con atrasos graves o créditos impagos. Las organizaciones denuncian que la licuación de ingresos obligó a las familias a financiarse mediante tarjetas, fintechs y prestamistas informales para cubrir costos básicos como alimentos, medicamentos, alquileres y servicios públicos.


Endeudados Organizados, demandan una “emergencia crediticia” y un programa público de desendeudamiento. Rechazan además la postura oficial del Gobierno de Javier Milei y el ministro Luis Caputo, quienes catalogaron la situación como “un tema entre privados”.


En conferencia de prensa, el Secretario General de la Cta Autónoma Hugo Godoy, describió la situación actual: “340.000 puestos de trabajo formales que se han destruido y cerca de 30.000 empresas que se siguen cerrando. Pero a esto se viene agregando ya no solamente el endeudamiento del país de futuras generaciones para pagar la deuda externa, sino también esta situación en que la caída del consumo y la caída de los ingresos de los trabajadores y trabajadoras obliga al endeudamiento”.


Además, responsabilizó al gobierno nacional por esto: “El gobierno se sigue haciendo el distraído, dice que es un problema de privados o el presidente encima dice que nadie les puso una pistola en la cabeza” y denunció que “la política de Milei es criminal, no solamente nos pone una pistola en la cabeza a los trabajadores y trabajadoras, sino que además nos mata, como mata a los jubilados y las jubiladas y como mata a los trabajadores y trabajadoras dejando a las familias sin sus puestos de trabajo”.


Por su parte, la Secretaria General Adjunta de la Unión de Trabajadoras y Trabajadores de la Economía Popular, aseveró: “Nosotras somos las compañeras, las cuidadoras comunitarias, las que venimos también compartiendo una pregunta a toda la sociedad y también a este gobierno” y se preguntó: “¿Quién cuida a las que nos endeudamos para sostener la vida de nuestras comunidades en los barrios populares? ¿Quién nos cuida a las que nos endeudamos para comprar comida? ¿Quién nos cuida cuando nos endeudamos para pedir un préstamo para comprar el medicamento para nuestros hijos?”.


Por último, el Co-Secretario General Confederación General del Trabajo y Secretario Regional de Camioneros Tres de Febrero y San Martín, aseguró que “cuando la deuda es para poder comer, es un problema social, y es un problema de la economía y un problema de gobierno” y enfatizó: “Quiere decir que acá hay dos culpables y dos responsables: el presidente y el ministro de Economía, quienes llevan una política totalmente de ajuste, regresiva, y totalmente pisando los salarios de los trabajadores, rompiendo totalmente el consumo, y lo peor de todo, rompiendo todo el sistema productivo”.

author: Tom Midlane
title: Jury Refuses to Convict Palestine Action Activists
content:
A jury has refused to convict seven Palestine Action activists in connection with a raid on an Israeli arms factory in South Gloucestershire.


The defendants were members of the Filton 25 who faced charges of criminal damage and violent disorder over the infiltration of Elbit Systems in Filton, near Bristol, in August 2024. 


Jurors deliberated for more than 37 hours but were unable to reach verdicts for seven of the eight defendants: Madeleine Norman, Hannah Davidson, Teuta Hoxha, Ola Aleksandra Herbich, Ian Sanders, William Plastow and Yulia Brigadirova. They may now face a retrial.


The eighth defendant, who cannot be named for legal reasons, was found guilty of criminal damage.


During the case, which opened at the Old Bailey on 22 June, Plastow was cleared of violent disorder after the judge concluded that the prosecution had not produced enough evidence. 


None of the eight defendants were on the premises of the Elbit factory at the time of the break-in. Police produced so little evidence against Brigadirova that her barrister told the court “she should be called the invisible coordinator,” reported

Declassified UK

.


Six of the Filton 25 activists were cleared of aggravated burglary charges in February following a trial at Woolwich Crown Court. Following that trial, aggravated burglary charges against 18 other defendants were dropped.


Elbit Systems is Israel’s largest weapons firm. It produces 85% of the military drone fleet used to massacre Palestinians in Gaza.


In response to the verdicts, the Filton 25 Defence Committee said the charges were an attempt by the state “to justify their disproportionate proscription of the group.”


The committee stated: “Today’s verdict comes after each of the defendants already spent up to 18 months in prison without convictions. They were all held on remand as ‘terrorist prisoners’ for well beyond the pre-trial custody time limit of six months.”


An additional trial would be “a huge waste of resources” and “a cynical attempt to manipulate the court process in order to convict the defendants”, it added.


“Each one of those drones could have massacred hundreds of Palestinians. Yet for destroying them and undoubtedly saving lives, four Palestine Action activists were sentenced as terrorists, despite only being convicted of criminal damage.”

author: Gustavo Faleiros
title: A comida está cara? Lamento informar, pode piorar
content:
Quer receber os textos desta coluna em primeira mão no seu e-mail? Assine a newsletter Ligando os pontos, enviada toda quinta-feira. Para receber as próximas edições,

inscreva-se aqui

.


Vou começar pedindo licença à minha colega colunista aqui da

Pública

, a

Clara Saliba

, pois vou me intrometer no campo dela, a economia. Não estudei economia, mas sempre me interessei por esta relação entre o desenvolvimento econômico e a natureza. Tive a sorte de começar minha carreira no jornalismo cobrindo macroeconomia. Foi a partir do olhar econômico que eu me liguei nas questões ambientais.


Nos dias de hoje, há um indicador que reflete como poucos essa relação entre a demanda por recursos naturais e o nosso cotidiano: a inflação.


Tivemos na semana passada uma notícia boa de que, no mês de julho,

o Índice de Preços ao Consumidor, o IPCA

, indicador oficial da taxa de inflação do Brasil, ficou abaixo do esperado – 4,4% no acumulado de 12 meses. Ou seja, um percentual menor do que o teto da meta anual de 4,5%. A notícia foi ainda melhor pois a queda no índice se deve principalmente à deflação de 0,67% nos alimentos. Uma redução no custo da alimentação não ocorria desde julho de 2022.


Entretanto, essa melhora não se reflete na percepção das pessoas. Quando falamos de inflação, um indicador exato, é notável como prevalecem os sentimentos. “O consumidor sentiu no bolso”, é um dos clichês favoritos. Ou ainda: “O supermercado está uma fortuna” e “não dá para comer fora toda hora.”


Essas percepções e sentimentos não são esotéricos ou descolados da realidade. Muito pelo contrário!

A nossa preocupação com o custo da comida está baseada em um problema estrutural: por conta das guerras e dos eventos climáticos extremos, o preço dos alimentos tem subido de forma constante.

 Isso sem falar nos choques repentinos. Em abril deste ano, por exemplo, o feijão deu um salto de 20%.


Um

estudo da Fundação Getúlio Vargas

 mostrou que o preço dos alimentos, nos últimos dez anos, aumentou mais do que a taxa média de inflação. Enquanto na última década a alta acumulada no IPCA foi de 44%, o indicador para Alimentos e Bebidas subiu 64%.


“Não é uma sensação, é uma constatação. Os preços realmente estão muito mais altos. Você tem 20 pontos percentuais de alta a mais para alimentos, e isso faz uma grande diferença, porque os salários são corrigidos pelo IPCA”, disse o economista André Braz, coordenador dos Índices de Preços do FGV IBRE, em

entrevista ao Jornal Nacional,


“Se o seu salário dos últimos seis anos foi corrigido em média em torno de 45%, mas a sua despesa de supermercado subiu 65%, então não são quedas pontuais [no valor do alimento] que vão fazer esse aumento todo dissipar.”


A inflação de alimentos passou a ser um problema na maioria dos países. Isso começou na pandemia devido às disrupções nas cadeias globais de fornecimento. Mas a alta se mostrou persistente e tomou um rumo ainda mais grave em 2022, quando começou o conflito entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia, que afetou tanto o mercado de fertilizantes como o de grãos. Foi exatamente em março daquele ano, um mês após o início da guerra, que o preço da soja bateu o recorde histórico – R$ 200 por saca.


Desde então, a soja permanece com valor acima de sua média histórica. A soja mais cara certamente alegra o setor agroexportador, mas também influencia no preço da proteína animal por aqui, em especial do frango. Para ligar os pontos com a questão ambiental, temos visto que a expansão da soja na Amazônia e no Matopiba (região agrícola no Maranhão, Tocantins, Piauí e Bahia) retomou o fôlego a ponto de termos grandes atores da cadeia atacando o acordo que garantia a produção apenas em áreas livres do desmatamento – a chamada moratória da soja.


A soja talvez possa parecer um mercado distante do nosso dia-a-dia, mas o preço do café certamente ficou na cabeça de todo mundo. No ano passado, em fevereiro, o café atingiu seu recorde histórico. Como podemos ver no gráfico abaixo, o preço do grão já vinha subindo desde 2020, ano da pandemia, e só no comecinho deste ano ele começou a dar uma aliviada. Mas aí, outro choque no preço dos alimentos chegou com a guerra dos Estados Unidos e Israel contra o Irã. O conflito no Estreito de Ormuz causou um salto nas cotações do petróleo e, por consequência, no custo dos combustíveis. Vejam, o café já começou a subir de novo!


Se por um lado muitas explicações para a alta nos alimentos se concentram nas guerras, por outro o fator climático …

author: David Swanson
title: Commemorating Hiroshima and Nagasaki Bombings in Scotland
content:
By North East Scotland CND – Campaigning for Peace, an affiliate of WBW, August 20,2026


“Turning nuclear remembrance into positive change”


On 8 August we held our annual gathering to remember those who died in the Hiroshima and Nagasaki nuclear bombings. And as the event was held outside Marischal College, central Aberdeen, we engaged with local passersby and made some new recruits for our cause!


Guest speaker Yu Aoki, who was born in Hiroshima but lives in Aberdeen, talked about the horror of the atomic bombings and the urgency of the current world situation. We heard inspiring and rousing music from Melting Pot, Bryan Duncan, and JC Bigfoot as well as poems and song lyrics read by local CND Activists.


Looking forward, Jonathan Russell, our Chair, spoke about our ongoing Welfare not Warfare campaign.


Here are some key highlights from Jonathan’s speech:


These solemn anniversaries can never be passive history. They are an urgent, annual

alarm bell as governments across the world are being urged to turn themselves into the

largest, most dangerous warfare states in history.


(On 5 March the Financial Times featured an article declaring): “Europe must trim 

its welfare state to build a warfare state.” That is what Labour chancellor John Healey 

wants us to believe, too. It is a dangerous lie.


A lie leading to growing inequality, deepening poverty, and an arms race which—like all

arms races in history—can lead only to war involving levels of devastation which will 

make Hiroshima and Nagasaki look primitive in their death dealing consequences.


This is why we must turn sorrowful remembrance into active resistance and the 

building of positive alternatives. That is, ones which resist the predatory  arms lobby, and

recognise that true human and national security is built on foundations of social security,

solidarity and democratic accountability.


The post

Commemorating Hiroshima and Nagasaki Bombings in Scotland

 appeared first on

World BEYOND War

.

title: Two ISIS members captured in Mosul and Salahaddin
content:
The Iraqi Directorate of Military Intelligence issued a statement regarding the capture of two ISIS members.


Acting on intelligence and as part of ongoing efforts to eliminate remaining ISIS cells, forces from the Directorate of Military Intelligence carried out two separate operations in the cities of Mosul and Salahaddin.


The statement said that two ISIS members, who were wanted under Article 4 of the Anti-Terrorism Law, were captured during the operations.


The detainees were handed over to the relevant authorities for the completion of legal proceedings and prosecution.

author: Unknown
title: Guerrillas celebrate 42nd anniversary of the August 15 Offensive
content:
Kurdish guerrillas marked the 42nd anniversary of the August 15 Offensive in several regions of the Medya Defense Zones in southern Kurdistan (northern Iraq). Videos of the events show gatherings attended by hundreds of members of the People’s Defense Forces (HPG) and the Free Women’s Troops (YJA-Star).


August 15 marks the beginning of the PKK’s armed struggle against the Turkish state in 1984 and is regarded as a historic turning point within the Kurdish freedom movement.


This year’s events focused in particular on the peace and  democratic society process initiated by PKK founder Abdullah Öcalan.


Commanders and members of the HPG and YJA-Star reaffirmed their determination to participate in the process initiated by Öcalan. At the same time, they described the physical freedom of the Kurdish leader as an indispensable prerequisite for the process to move forward.

title: Murat Çepni'yi ziyaret eden Hatimoğulları'ndan Silivri önünde çağrı: 'Siyasi tutsakların özgürlüğü süreci ileriye taşıyacak'
content:
Halkların Eşitlik ve Demokrasi Partisi (DEM Parti) Eş Genel Başkanı Tülay Hatimoğulları ve Bitlis Milletvekili Hüseyin Olan, Silivri Cezaevinde tutuklu bulunan ESP Eş Genel Başkanı Murat Çepni’yi ziyaret etti. Görüşmede ‘çerçeve yasa’ ve gündemdeki gelişmeler değerlendirildi.

Ziyaretin ardından açıklamalarda bulunan Hatimoğulları, ESP’ye yönelik operasyonların 200. gününü geride bıraktığını hatırlatarak, "ESP’ye gerçekleşen operasyonda 110 kişi hakkında gözaltı kararı vardı ve 84 sosyalist o günlerde tutuklandı. Aralarında ESP Eş Genel Başkanı ve önceki dönem HDP Milletvekili Murat Çepni'nin de bulunduğu 48 arkadaşımız şu an hala tutuklu. Arkadaşlarımız Türkiye'de adil ve demokratik bir düzen istedikleri için hapishanede" dedi. Tahliye çağrısını yineleyen Hatimoğulları, "Başta Murat Çepni Eş Başkanımız olmak üzere bütün ESP'li yoldaşlarımız serbest bırakılmalıdır" ifadelerini kullandı.

‘Çerçeve yasa’ya değinen Hatimoğulları, "Çerçeve yasayı bu ülkede 50 yıldır devam eden savaş ve çatışmaları, Kürt sorununun çözümsüzlüğünü, Kürt sorununu 'terör' parantezine alan anlayışa karşı atılmış bir ilk adım olarak değerlendiriyoruz. Bizler biliyoruz ki bu yasanın çıkması tek başına Türkiye'yi demokratikleştirmeyecek ama demokratikleşmenin önünü ardına kadar açabilir" ifadelerini kullandı.

Diyalog sürecinde somut adımlar atılması gerektiğini vurgulayan Hatimoğulları, "Barış ve demokratikleşme sürecinin başladığı ve diyalogların sürdüğü bu dönemde iyi niyet adımları olarak AİHM kararları bir an önce hayata geçirilmeli, hem Kobanî hem Gezi Davasındaki bütün mahpuslar acilen serbest bırakılmalı. Siyasilere, seçilmişlere dönük yargı operasyonu derhal bitmelidir" diye konuştu.

Süreçte Öcalan'ın rolüne ilişkin değerlendirmelerde de bulunan Hatimoğulları, "Sayın Öcalan'ın Barış ve Demokratik Toplum Sürecindeki rolü ve payı çok büyük. Bu sürecin bir başlatıcısı Sayın Bahçeli, bir diğer başlatıcısı da Sayın Abdullah Öcalan'dır. DEM Parti'nin önümüzdeki günlerde gireceği yeniden yapılanma sürecinde Sayın Öcalan'ın sunacağı görüşler ve değerlendirmeler de son derece kıymetli olacaktır" ifadelerini kullandı.

DEM Parti'deki yeniden yapılanma sürecine ve Abdullah Öcalan'ın bu süreçteki konumuna değinen Hatimoğulları, “Sol sosyalistlerle, yurtseverlerle, demokrasi güçleriyle, kadın hareketiyle, ekoloji hareketiyle ortak zeminimiz olan DEM Parti'nin önümüzdeki günlerde bir yeniden yapılanma sürecine gireceğini de kamuoyuyla paylaşmıştık. Bu yeniden yapılanma sürecinde Sayın Öcalan'ın sunacağı görüşler ve değerlendirmeler de son derece kıymetli olacaktır” şeklinde konuştu.

Açıklamalar yaptığı esnasında İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi Başkanı Ekrem İmamoğlu'nun yargılanmasının devam ettiğini belirten Hatimoğulları, " Siyasilere, seçilmişlere dönük yargı operasyonu derhal bitmelidir. Yargı operasyonları devam ettiği sürece bir demokratikleşme sürecinden bahsetmek neredeyse imkansızlaşmış durumdadır. Bugün hala belediyelerimize atanmış olan kayımlar yerli yerinde durmaktadır. Kayyım yasası bir an önce geri çekilmeli ve bir an önce seçilmişlerimiz görevlerine iade edilmelidir. Yargılanan belediye başkanları için şu vurguyu da çok yaptık. Varsa yargılanmaları gereken bir mesele, varsa bir yolsuzluk gelin Meclis’te bir komisyon kuralım ve iktidar partisi dahil olmak üzere, DEM Parti dahil olmak üzere bütün belediyeler incelensin" şeklinde konuştu.

title: Tarihi Fransız Yetimhanesi’nde fotoğrafın 200 yıllık yolculuğu
content:
Beyoğlu’nun tarihi mekanlarından birisi olan Eski Fransız Yetimhanesi, Dünya Fotoğrafçılık Günü dolayısıyla düzenlenen özel programa ev sahipliği yaptı. Tarihteki ilk fotoğrafın çekildiği orijinal mekanda çekimleri tamamlanan özel belgesel, ilk kez fotoğraf severlerle buluştu.

19 Ağustos Dünya Fotoğrafçılık Günü, Eski Fransız Yetimhanesi’nin tarihi atmosferinde düzenlenen programla kutlandı. FOTON Derneği ve Beyoğlu Belediyesi iş birliğiyle gerçekleştirilen özel etkinlik, fotoğraf sevdalılarını bir araya getirdi. Özel sergi, söyleşi ve atölye çalışmasının yapıldığı etkinlikler, FOTON Derneği temsilcileri ve Beyoğlu Belediyesi Başkan Vekili Sefer Karaahmetoğlu’nun açılış konuşmalarıyla başladı.

​Açılışın ardından FOTON Derneği üyelerinin eserlerinden oluşan Karma Fotoğraf Gösterisi izleyicilerin beğenisine sunuldu. Gecenin öne çıkan anlarından biri ise fotoğrafın 200. yılı vesilesiyle FOTON Derneği tarafından hazırlanan özel belgeselin ilk gösterimi oldu. Tarihteki ilk fotoğrafın çekildiği orijinal mekanda çekimleri tamamlanan belgesel, davetlilerden ilgi gördü.

​Belgesel gösteriminin ardından düzenlenen “Fotoğrafın 200. Yılında Geçmişten Geleceğe” başlıklı söyleşide; Murat Gür, Prof. Ozan Bilgiseren ve Tanın Helvacı fotoğraf sanatının tarihsel gelişimini ve geleceğini dinleyicilerle paylaştı.

​Etkinlik boyunca devam eden “Alaminüt Fotoğraf Çekim Deneyimi” alanında ise Sena Turhan (Photogram 1827) rehberliğinde katılımcılar, geleneksel ahşap kutu kameralarla tarihi çekim tekniğini birebir deneyimleme fırsatı buldu.

title: Ankara Tabip Odası: 'Yoksulluk yalnızca ekonomik bir olgu değil, halk sağlığı sorunudur'
content:
Ankara Tabip Odası (ATO) Yönetim Kurulu ve Halk Sağlığı Komisyonu, yoksulluğun yalnızca finansal bir yetersizlik olmadığını, barınma ve beslenmeden sağlık hizmetlerine erişim ile çocuk gelişimine kadar hayatın tüm alanlarını doğrudan etkileyen ciddi bir toplum sağlığı problemi olduğunu vurguladı. Açıklamada, bireylerin sağlık durumunun aldıkları maaş, tükettikleri gıda, yaşadıkları konut, çalışma şartları, eğitim imkânları ve gelecek güvencesiyle doğrudan ilişkili olduğu ifade edildi.

TÜİK’in 2025 Gelir Dağılımı İstatistikleri ile Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler Bakanlığı’nın 2026 verilerini değerlendiren ATO, gelir adaletsizliğinin ulaştığı boyutlara dikkat çekti. Türkiye'de en yüksek gelire sahip yüzde 20’lik kesimin toplam gelirin yüzde 48’ini alırken, en yoksul yüzde 20’nin yalnızca yüzde 6,4 pay alabildiği hatırlatıldı. En zengin yüzde 20’nin gelirinin en alt dilimdeki yüzde 20’nin 7,5 katına, en zengin yüzde 10’un ise en yoksul yüzde 10’un 12,9 katına ulaştığı belirtilerek, bu derin uçurumun doğrudan halkın yaşam kalitesini ve sağlığını tehdit ettiği kaydedildi.

Raporda paylaşılan verilere göre, nüfusun yüzde 28,8’i nem, çatı sızıntısı ve çürümüş pencere gibi yapısal konut sorunlarıyla mücadele ederken, yüzde 27,9’u ise yalıtım yetersizliği yüzünden evini ısıtamıyor. Yetersiz ısınan ve sağlıksız binaların özellikle çocuklarda solunum yolu enfeksiyonları ve psikolojik rahatsızlık riskini ciddi biçimde artırdığına dikkat çekildi.

Ailesinin yanında asgari ihtiyaçları dahi karşılanamayan çocuk sayısının son 8 yılda yüzde 58 oranında artışla 122 binden 193 binin üzerine çıktığı aktarıldı. 2026'nın ilk yarısında yaklaşık 1,86 milyon kişinin Şartlı Eğitim ve Şartlı Sağlık Yardımı aldığı, 2017-2026 yılları arasında ise 55 binden fazla çocuğun sokakta risk altında tespit edildiği bildirildi.

Çocukluk çağındaki beslenme yetersizliğinin gelişim geriliği, anemi, bağışıklık zayıflığı ve öğrenme güçlüğüne neden olduğunu belirten ATO, bu tablonun yetişkinlikte diyabet, obezite ve kardiyovasküler hastalıklar gibi kronik problemlere dönüştüğünü vurguladı. Bu durumun nesiller boyu aktarılan bir sağlık eşitsizliği döngüsü oluşturduğu ifade edildi.

Sağlığın sadece hastane koridorlarında inşa edilemeyeceğinin altı çizilen açıklamada, adil vergilendirme, insanca yaşanabilir ücret ve emekli maaşı seviyeleri, okullarda ücretsiz ve nitelikli yemek programları, herkese eşit ve ücretsiz birinci basamak sağlık hizmeti ile barınma hakkının güvenceye alınması gibi kamucu politikaların ivedilikle hayata geçirilmesi gerektiği belirtildi.

title: Vogliono estradare Gino: resoconto dell’udienza del 19/08
content:
Ripubblichiamo il comunicato di Free All Antifas in modo da diffondere il più possibile la campagna di solidarietà nei confronti di Gino da ieri a rischio estradizione.


VOGLIONO ESTRADARE GINO


URGENTE – RESOCONTO DELL’UDIENZA DEL 19/08: LA CORTE SI PRONUNCIA A FAVORE DELL’ESTRADIZIONE DI GINO


Oggi si è tenuta l’udienza del nostro compagno e amico Gino davanti alla Corte d’appello di Parigi, che si è pronunciata a favore della sua estradizione in Germania entro 10 giorni. I giudici hanno ceduto alle pressioni dell’Unione Europea e di Europol, calpestando tutti i principi dell’indipendenza della magistratura e delle libertà fondamentali.


Fin dall’inizio del caso Budapest, la Germania si è dimostrata particolarmente severa, condannando diversi compagni a pene detentive effettive. Se Gino venisse estradato, rischierebbe almeno 10 anni di reclusione in Germania, ma possiamo davvero fidarci di un paese che non ha esitato a violare le regole più elementari del diritto estradando in Ungheria Maja, detenuta da due anni in condizioni indegne? Ricordiamo che l’Ungheria aveva richiesto l’estradizione di Gino, che rischiava 24 anni di reclusione nelle carceri ungheresi. La Francia aveva deciso di rifiutare la sua estradizione e deve farlo anche nei confronti della Germania, che vuole fare di questo caso un esempio contro gli antifascisti.


Abbiamo poco tempo: è più che mai necessario mobilitarsi in massa e dimostrare il proprio sostegno in ogni modo possibile (comunicati di sostegno, striscioni, manifesti, raduni davanti alle ambasciate, ecc.) per evitare a Gino un’imminente estradizione.


Non allentiamo la pressione e continuiamo il nostro lavoro di solidarietà: Gino non deve essere estradato.

author: Unknown
title: 20 people from the Kurdistan Region went missing on migration route to Europe this year
content:
Bekir Ali, head of the Association of Returned Refugees, held a press conference at the Migration Office in Ranya district in the Raparin Administration.


Stating that young people are taking dangerous routes in an attempt to migrate to Europe, Bekir Ali said, “Yesterday, 36 people who were being held by human-smuggling gangs were rescued by Libyan National Defense forces and handed over to Iraq. Those rescued had traveled to Libya earlier this month with the aim of reaching Europe.”


Bekir Ali reported that some young people from the Kurdistan Region who had attempted to migrate through irregular routes were missing. Some have been missing since March 15, 2026, while others have not been heard from since the end of last month, Ali said. He added that the Association of Returned Refugees has repeatedly warned people about the dangers of the routes used for migration.


Referring to efforts carried out with the support of the Iraqi Ministry of Foreign Affairs and a group of volunteers, Bekir Ali said that since November 2025 and January 2026, 253 citizens from the Kurdistan Region had been rescued from human smugglers in Libya through initiatives by the Kurdistan Region’s Department of Foreign Relations. He said the migrants had faced threats, harassment and torture along the migration route, while their families had been forced to pay large sums of money to secure their release.


Bekir Ali said they had expected migration rates to decline at the beginning of the year, but their monitoring showed that irregular migration remained at a high level.


He added that 20 people have gone missing this year while attempting to travel along these dangerous routes.


Emphasizing that migration continues across the Kurdistan Region, Bekir Ali said the rate is particularly high within the Raparin Administration.

title: Amedspor fan groups organize against drugs
content:
In Amed (Turkish: Diyarbakır), Amedspor fan groups are joining the fight against the increasing spread of drugs. As part of the “Rabin” [Stand Up] campaign, they aim to reach children and young people in particular and expand their activities from the football stands into the city’s neighborhoods. The fans identify community organizing and self-defense as key means of combating drug addiction.


The “Rabin” campaign, launched by the “Şiyar Be!” platform against special warfare policies and the spread of drugs, is now continuing with actions in several cities. While vigils and demonstrations are being held elsewhere, meetings are organized almost daily in neighborhoods across Amed. Residents discuss the impact of drug addiction on families and community life. Public spaces such as parks and areas beneath bridges are considered particularly problematic. At the same time, local initiatives are being established in different parts of the city to address drugs, gambling and other social problems.


Four fan groups join forces


Amedspor fan groups have also brought their existing activities together. Ferhat Yıldız of the Azadî fan group said they had already been involved in efforts against drugs before the campaign was launched. By joining forces with three other groups, they are now able to expand their work.


The consequences, he said, have become increasingly visible in their immediate social environment. “We see it in our families, among our friends and in our neighborhoods. It has spread everywhere,” Yıldız said.


According to the fan groups’ observations, even children as young as eight or nine are now coming into contact with drugs. “We are determined to fight against this,” Yıldız said. “We are already doing so, and we will continue to do so.”


“We want to say: Enough is enough”


Rojhat Koyun of the Direniş fan group also spoke about years of activism against drugs and social deterioration. In recent weeks, the fans have intensified their activities in the streets and neighborhoods. “We have reached our limit. As young people and as fan groups, we want to say: Enough is enough,” Koyun said. Drugs and other forms of social exploitation, he added, have reached a level in Amed that can no longer be tolerated.


According to Koyun, their organizing efforts have already been met with state repression. Three young people were recently forcibly detained because of their involvement and subsequently placed in pre-trial detention. However, he said this would not affect the continuation of the campaign: “We have faced many difficulties. But that will never stop or intimidate us.”


The fan groups also want to raise awareness of their initiative beyond Amed. “As Amedspor fan groups and as the youth of Amed, we want to make a start,” Koyun said. The aim is to encourage young people in other cities to organize against drugs and social deterioration as well.


Young people should turn to sports, not drugs


Baran Çınar of the Barikat fan group, founded in 2014, sees its participation in the “Rabin” campaign as a continuation of years of activism. The campaign now provides an opportunity to build a stronger collective voice against drugs and other forms of addiction. “Drugs destroy people, families, the country—they destroy everything,” Çınar said. “We are doing this so that our young people are not poisoned and instead turn to sports.”


The initiative is explicitly intended to extend beyond the area around the stadium. Parks, streets and other public spaces in the city’s neighborhoods, in particular, need to be reclaimed.


“The way forward is through organizing and self-defense”


According to Çınar, the widespread prevalence of drugs among young people cannot be viewed separately from the political situation. For years, voices within Kurdish society have argued that drugs, gambling and organized crime are used as part of state special warfare policies to weaken social organizing and, in particular, to distance young people from political and community life.


The response, he said, therefore cannot be limited to individual measures to combat addiction. “We can overcome this through organizing,” Çınar said. “This struggle is built on organizing and self-defense.” Drugs, he continued, are part of a policy that “distances young people from politics and social life.”


The fan groups intend to confront this collectively. “As young people, as Barikat and as fan councils, we will never allow this path to be imposed on us …

title: Wezareta Parastina Neteweyî: Li Ebu Zuhurê ti şandeyeke leşkerî ya Tirk tune bû
content:
Wezareta Parastina Neteweyî (MSB) derbarê êrişa Îsraîlê ya li ser Balafirgeha Leşkerî ya Ebu Zuhurê ya li Sûriyeyê ku nêzîkî 70 kîlometreyan dûrî sînorê Tirkiyeyê ye, daxuyaniyek da.


Wezaretê aşkere kir ku berî êrişê û di dema êrişê de li baregehê ti şandeyeke leşkerî ya ji Tirkiyeyê tune bû.


Êrişa 'Ebu Zuhur'ê ya Îsraîlê tê çi wateyê?


19 Tebax 2026


Berdevkê MSBê fermandar Zeki Akturk, di çarçoveya TEKNOFEST Mavi Vatanê de li ser keştiya TCG Koçhisarê ya li Kocaêliyê civîna heftane ya agahdarkirina çapemeniyê li dar xist.


Akturkî got:

“Tişta ji bo me girîng ew e ku em rê li ber alozî û bêaramiya li herêma xwe bigirin û nehêlin zêdetir şer lê rû bide da ku aştî û ewlehî lê mayînde bibe.”

 Her weha Akturk destnîşan kir ku ji bo parastina serwerî û yekparçeyiya xaka Sûriyeyê û ji bo bibe cihê aramî û ewlehiyê dê tevkarî û piştgiriya wan bi ‘biryardarî’ berdewam bike.


Şandeyek ji Wezareta Berevaniyê serdana Sûriyeyê kir


30 Çile 2025


“Divê Îsraîl dawî li van êrişên xwe yên bêperwa bîne”


Li gorî nûçeya Ajansa Anadoluyê, piştî civînê Wezaretê bersiva pirsên ji bo êrişa Îsraîlê ya li ser ‘Ebu Zuhur’ê da:


"Êrişa ku Îsraîlê li dijî Baregeha Hewayî ya Ebu Zuhurê pêk aniye, çalakiyeke ku zirarê dide aramî, ewlehî, yekîtî, yekparçeyî û di heman demê de binesaziya Sûriyeyê. Em di her firsendê de destnîşan dikin ku êrişên li dijî serwerî û yekparçeyiya xaka Sûriyeyê nayên qebûlkirin. Em diyar dikin ku berî êrişa Îsraîlê ya li ser baregeha hewayî ya Ebu Zuhurê ya li Sûriyeyê ango di dema êrişê de ti şandeyek leşkerî ya Tirk li baregehê tune bû. Him ji bo aramiya Sûriyeyê û him jî ji bo ya herêmê divê Îsraîl dawî li van êrişên xwe yên bêperwa bîne û mercên hiqûqa navneteweyî bicih bike. Em ê di çarçoveya prensîba 'yek artêşî' de piştgiriya avakirina binesazî û kapasîteya leşkerî ya Sûriyeyê bikin."


Çi bûbû?


Balafirên şerî yên Îsraîlê, sibaha 18ê Tebaxê li bakurê rojavayê Sûriyeyê, Balafirgeha Leşkerî ya Ebu Zuhurê ku bejahiya rojhilatê Îdlibê ye, kir armanc.


Li gorî agahiyên ku televîzyona dewletê ya Sûriyeyê spartine çavkaniyeke leşkerî, rêya firînê û depoyên baregehê bi heşt

êrişên hewayî

 bûne armanc. Çavkaniyên herêmî û leşkerî behsa windahiyên canî nekirine, lê di tesîsê de zirara madî çêbûye.


Ebu Zuhur nêzîkî 70 kîlomêtreyan li rojhilatê sînorê Tirkiyeyê ye. Demeke dirêj bû bi awayekî çalak wekî balafirgeheke leşkerî nedihat bi kar anîn. Lêbelê ji ber ku li ser rêya derbasbûnê ya di navbera bajarên Hema û Helebê de ye û nêzîkî çola Sûriyeyê ye, girîngiyeke wê ya stratejîk heye.


Li gorî nûçeya El-Erebî el-Cedîd ku navenda wê li Londonê ye û bi erebî weşanê dike, rojek berê êrişê şandeyeke leşkerî ya ji Tirkiyeyê serdana Ebu Zuhurê kiriye.


Li gorî nûçeyê, şandeyê lêkolîn li ser xebatên yekem ên ji bo jinûve vekirina rêya firînê kirine. Çavkaniyan ji El-Erebî el-Cedîdê re îdîa kirine ku xebat hê di qonaxa destpêkê de ne, di nav baregehê de hin amûrên ragihandinê hene û li ser herêmê droneke keşfê ya cureyê Bayraktarê difiriya. Hat diyarkirin ku piştî vegera şandeyê ji herêmê, balafireke keşfê ya Îsraîlê li derdora baregehê firiyaye û êriş jî piştî çend saetan pêk hatiye.


Malbenda Çavdêriyê ya Mafên Mirovan a Sûriyeyê ku navenda wê li Londonê ye jî îdîayeke weke vê derbirî.


(VC/AY)

author: Mag
title: [Die Anstalt] Sanifair: Bezahlen für Toilettenbenutzung?
content:
Bezahlen für Toilettenbenutzung? Ein Thema für die Anstalt! Die beiden Kabarettisten Rainald Grebe und Matthias Egersdörfer mit einer Nummer über die Abzocke mit den Sanifair-Toiletten auf deutschen Autobahnraststätten – musikalisch begleitet von der Chemnitzer Band „Kraftklub“. Weltpremiere: MC Grebe feat. MC Egersdörfer & Kraftklub zum Thema Sanifair.

Video des Auftritts in der Anstalt-Sendung vom 9.12.2014 in der ZDF-Mediathek


 und nun

auf youtube

 


. Der Kabarettist Rainald Grebe ist – leider erfolglos – gegen die Kostenpflicht juristisch vorgegangen, siehe Infos dazu:


[Report Mainz] Ausgebeutet für Sanifair? Schmutzige Geschäfte mit sauberen Toiletten 


„

Es sind schwere Vorwürfe, die Reinigungskräfte bei Report Mainz erheben. Sie schildern, in Sanifair-Toilettenanlagen täglich zwölf Stunden arbeiten zu müssen. Sieben Tage die Woche. Dafür erhielten sie einen Stundenlohn von rund fünf Euro.


„Sie haben keine Ahnung, was wir jeden Tag durchmachen und wie wir gedemütigt werden. Wir werden wie Tiere behandelt. Am Ende werfen sie dich weg wie einen nutzlosen Gegenstand.“ Diesen Hilferuf hatte eine Reinigungskraft an Report Mainz geschickt. Wochenlang stand der Mann aus Bulgarien mit dem ARD-Politikmagazin in Kontakt. Er will nicht erkannt werden, aus Angst um seinen Job. Zu seinem Schutz nennen wir ihn Anton. Er reinigt nach eigenen Angaben seit mehr als einem Jahr Sanifair-Toiletten an einer Tank-&-Rast-Anlage. Jeden Tag zwölf Stunden. Trotz für ihn unzumutbarer Arbeitsbedingungen müsse er weitermachen. Denn er wohne in der Unterkunft seines Arbeitgebers und habe Angst, auf der Straße zu landen.


Um die Aussagen zu überprüfen, dokumentierte Report Mainz selbst an mehreren Raststätten bundesweit, wie lange Reinigungskräfte dort arbeiten. Diese Recherchen ergaben: Tatsächlich sind die Personen an den dokumentieren Raststätten täglich zwölf Stunden im Einsatz. Mehrere Reinigungskräfte berichten zudem von einem Stundenlohn von rund fünf Euro. Das liegt deutlich unter dem tariflichen Mindestlohn für Gebäudereiniger von 15 Euro pro Stunde.


Reinigung durch Subunternehmer


Wer an Raststätten der Tank-&-Rast-Gruppe die Toilette nutzt, zahlt einen Euro beim Tochterunternehmen Sanifair und erhält dafür einen Wertbon. Anton arbeitet jedoch nicht direkt für Sanifair, sondern für eine Firma aus Bulgarien. Das Subunternehmen reinigt für Raststättenpächter Sanifair-Toiletten. Laut Vertrag ist Anton als freiberuflicher Mitarbeiter tätig.


Report Mainz hat die Recherchen einem Arbeitsrechtler vorgelegt. Florian Rödl hält das Beschäftigungsverhältnis für eine abhängige Beschäftigung. „Das ist einfach strafbarer Betrug. Und da wir es hier nicht mit einem Einzelfall zu tun haben, ist es ein Betrug in großem Stil, der eigentlich auch hohe Strafdrohungen auf sich ziehen müsste“, so Rödl

…“

Beitrag von Anna Stradinger und Aleksandra van de Pol, SWR, vom 18.08.2026 auf tagesschau.de


 zum

Beitrag in der Sendung Report Mainz am 18. August

 


Sanifair nimmt viel ein mit der Notdurft: Das Ding mit den Wertebons


„

Auf Autobahnraststätten kostet einmal aufs Klo gehen 70 Cent bei Sanifair. Dafür gibt es einen Wertbon von 50 Cent. Ein gutes Geschäft. Für Sanifair. (…)


Sanifair ist die Tochterfirma des Autobahn-Raststätten-Betreibers Tank & Rast. Der Konzern war einst staatlich und wurde dann für 1,3 Milliarden DM verkauft (nachdem er alle Einrichtungen der MITROPA übernommen hatte): an den Finanzinvestor Terra Firma und einen Fonds der Deutschen Bank.

2015 verkaufte Tank & Rast an ein Konsortium „um den Versicherungsriesen Allianz. Zu der Käufergruppe gehören daneben der kanadische Infrastruktur-Fonds Borealis, der Staatsfonds von Abu Dhabi, ADIA, und die Münchener-Rück-Tochter MEAG,“ meldete die „Tagesschau“. Der Kaufpreis für die 390 Raststätten, 350 Tankstellen und 50 Hotels betrug 3,5 Milliarden Euro. Jährlich muss Tank & Rast dem Staat Konzessionsgebühren um 17 Millionen Euro zahlen, dieser hält dafür die Anlagen für 110 Millionen Euro im Jahr instand.


Im Privatisierungsvertrag hieß es 2016: „Die Tank & Rast wird sich bemühen, die unentgeltliche Benutzung von sanitären Einrichtungen ganzjährig durchgehend sicherzustellen.“ Sie bemühte sich aber nicht. Gegen die Kostenpflicht bei Benutzung der Toilettenanlagen ist der Kabarettist Rainald Grebe juristisch vorgegangen – jedoch erfolglos. Unterdes hat sich der Abgeordnete Victor Perli (Linke) zu einem weiteren Sanifair-Gegner profiliert.


Benzin ist ausgenommen …

author: Darío Aranda
title: La balcanización de Argentina
content:
Divide y vencerás

 - Julio César


OPINIÓN


Por Diego García Ríos


Balcanización: dícese del proceso por el cual un territorio que antes estaba relativamente integrado se fragmenta en varios Estados, regiones o entidades políticas más pequeñas, generalmente debido a conflictos políticos, étnicos, religiosos, económicos o territoriales. El término proviene de la región de los Balcanes, especialmente de la fragmentación del antiguo Imperio Otomano y, más tarde, de la disolución de Yugoslavia.


Y ese proceso de fragmentación territorial es el que está viviendo Argentina hoy, a instancias de la política del garrote que les impone este gobierno nacional a las provincias. Asistimos a tiempos en que los gobernadores se manejan con el “sálvese quien pueda”, donde las gestiones se pelean por huesos que casi no tienen carne para pellizcar. El ahogo presupuestario a las provincias es tal y el maniqueísmo entre los actores es tan fuerte, que se termina apelando a un discurso de falso federalismo que no hace más que traicionar los principios con que tantas voces del siglo XIX enarbolaron esas banderas.


Un par de culos va a patear, de los que le juran más lealtad

- Patricio Rey y sus Redonditos de Ricota


Primer escenario: no hay plata


Desde que el gobierno de Javier Milei asume la presidencia, se manejó con el mismo discurso de insuficiencia presupuestaria (en pos del pago de la deuda externa y del mentado “equilibrio fiscal”), incumpliendo todo tipo de marco legal: desde la Constitución Nacional (1994) hasta la Coparticipación Federal (Ley 23.548, sancionada en 1988). No es el primer gobierno que maneja la caja a discreción según la simpatía política (o, mejor dicho, la genuflexión) de cada gobernador/a, pero lo que sí es una novedad es que no solo no remite fondos básicos, sino que espeta todo tipo de insultos a quienes le dan gobernabilidad (por ejemplo, mediante la firma del llamado “Pacto de Mayo”) o le ofrecen votos en el Congreso mediante los diputados y senadores, que se manejan como cortesanos de los propios gobernadores.


Foto: Nico Freda


Tengo los dedos ateridos de tanto esperar a ese auto que me lleve por las Rutas argentinas

 -

Almendra


Segundo escenario

: l

a no inversión en obra pública


Hoy los dedos estarían ateridos, pero ya no de esperar, sino de transitar por las rutas argentinas. El estado paupérrimo y calamitoso del sistema de interconexión nacional es tan grande que eso no solo atenta contra el desarrollo productivo de un país, sino que se convierte en un asesino silencioso de víctimas que se cobra la desinversión vial.


Si bien la situación es preocupante desde hace muchas décadas, el actual es el primer gobierno que, de manera explícita y deliberada, decide no invertir un solo peso en reparar o mantener rutas, y mucho menos, construir nuevas para comunicar la gran extensión argentina.


Bajo el argumento de que es un asunto que deberían tomar agentes privados para invertir, la realidad es que muchas rutas nacionales y provinciales poseen cráteres lunares, tienen escasa o nula señalización y la experiencia de transitar caminos se parece más a una aventura arriesgada que a una experiencia placentera.


Vale decir que esta situación comenzó a abrirse gracias al menemismo de los noventa (enaltecido por la administración actual), que tomó la decisión política de “camionizar” las rutas en detrimento del transporte ferroviario; situación que los gobiernos posteriores tampoco se esmeraron demasiado en revertir. Entonces, cada gobierno provincial suplica las migajas que le permitan, de manera escueta, sostener las condiciones mínimas de transitabilidad. Todo esto, por supuesto, sin criterio de desarrollo territorial nacional ni provincial alguno.


Foto: Nico Freda


Vas corriendo con tus Nikes y las balas van detrás

(lo que duele no es la goma, sino su velocidad)


Indio Solari y los Fundamentalistas del Aire Acondicionado


Tercer escenario

:

RIGI y reforma laboral


El Gobierno aseguró que viene a cambiar las cosas de raíz, estructuralmente. Es por eso que apela al siniestro Ministerio de Desregulación para quitar lo que ellos llaman la “hojarasca estatizante” que atenta contra la libertad (de empresa), que no son más que marcos normativos y regulatorios con los que cuenta la población para que el abuso de este sistema desigual no sea tan notorio.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: AI Superintelligence Is Not a Tool, It's an Adversary Threatening Humanity: ControlAI's Connor Leahy
content:
Sixty-nine-year-old Wynd Kaufmyn, a retired teacher from Berkeley, California, is believed to be the first person imprisoned for protesting the development of artificial intelligence, after she and other members of the group StopAI were arrested during a sit-in protest at the headquarters of OpenAI.

Democracy Now!

 reached Kaufmyn at the San Francisco County Jail, where she is now serving a two-week sentence for charges including “interfering with a business.” Kaufmyn says she participated in the protest because “This technology is fueling a dystopian level of surveillance. It’s fueling a fascist state. It’s going to take all of our jobs. It’s already taken many of them. It’s causing suicides, homicides and mass shootings. This needs to stop.”


Another group, named ControlAI, has made it a mission to brief lawmakers on “adversarial” threats from unchecked emergent technologies. We speak to ControlAI’s executive director, Connor Leahy, who first came to national prominence for reverse-engineering OpenAI’s

GPT

-2 model in his college dorm room in 2019. “Even though I was able to build such an AI system, I was not able to understand it,” says Leahy, who warns against the development of autonomous so-called superintelligence and calls for governments to “criminalize the creation of superintelligence the same way that it is illegal to build a nuclear bomb.”

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Nunavik partners with Cité Joie to provide temporary housing
content:
The Nunavik Regional Board of Health and Social Services has partnered with a non-profit to provide Nunavimmiut living with disability, autism or mental health conditions the opportunity to stay at a camp outside Quebec City that meets their needs.


The agreement with Cité Joie covers respite stays for up to one month and temporary housing for stays of one month to one year, for individuals who meet eligibility requirements.


The facility in Lac-Beauport, just outside Quebec City, has seven rooms, a shared living room, a kitchen and a full-time nurse on site, said Olivier Piquer, Cité Joie’s director general. It’s located in a forested area with open green spaces and a lake. There are structured activities for visitors during their stay.


“During our discussions with the regional authority, they were looking for a setting that resembled the Nunavik environment; something close to nature and deeply connected to it,” he said Tuesday in a French interview.


“People would be able to be independent in their rooms while having a living environment that is small and easy to live in.”


The partnership comes as the Nunavik faces a shortage of transitional and supportive housing for people who need specialized support, the board said in an email.


About 38 Nunavimmiut are currently waiting to access housing that better meets their needs.


The health board said the partnership is intended as a temporary measure while longer term, culturally safe housing and support services are developed in the region.


The organization is working with the board to adapt the décor, food and activities to Inuit culture. Plans include incorporating Inuit crafts and outdoor activities such as fishing, Piquer said.


“Residents are here to receive respite and we’re here to provide that respite, but we’re also here to learn with them,” he said, adding that the first residents arrived sometime in late July, early August.


Piquer said the partnership’s success would be measured by how well the residents integrate into the Cité Joie community while maintaining their cultural identity and individual needs.


The health board echoed that sentiment, adding that success would also mean getting people the housing and support they need in a timely way.


The partnership costs $800,000 over two years, said the health board.

title: Αντιδράσεις των κατοίκων των χωριών του Πηλίου ενάντια στα σχέδια Μπέου να υφαρπάξει τα νερά των πηγών της περιοχής – ΦΩΤΟ
content:
ΑΝΤΑΠΟΚΡΙΣΗ Μ.Τ.


Στο πόδι πάλι τα χωριά του Πηλίου που ανήκουν στον δήμο Βόλου με επίκεντρο τον Άγιο Βλάσιο και τα Άνω Λεχώνια. Αφορμή η εμμονή του δήμαρχου Αχ. Μπέου να βάλει χέρι στα νερά των πηγών της περιοχής βάσει ενός master plan της ΔΕΥΑΜΒ με θέμα την διαχείριση του νερού μέχρι το 2050.


Σύμφωνα με αυτό το σχέδιο διαχείρισης, προβλέπεται η μεταφορά πόσιμου νερού στο πολεοδομικό συγκρότημα του Βόλου από τις πηγές Άη Γιάννη και Ζιάγκα. Οι κάτοικοι των δύο χωριών αντιδρούν δυναμικά εκφράζοντας την αντίθεσή τους. Συνέταξαν και κατέθεσαν στις αρμόδιες υπηρεσίες του δήμου και της περιφέρειας τη δική τους επιστημονική μελέτη. Αντικρούουν τις εσφαλμένες εκτιμήσεις των μελετητών σε σχέση με τις πραγματικές δυνατότητες τροφοδοσίας με πηγαίο πόσιμο νερό των κατοίκων του Βόλου.


Επισημαίνουν το μεγάλο περιβαλλοντικό πρόβλημα που θα προκύψει από την επιχειρούμενη εφαρμογή της μελέτης και καταγγέλουν τη δημοτική αρχή για άρνηση διαλόγου και παντελή αδιαφορία για τις ανάγκες των χωριών.


Η Επιτροπή Αγώνα οργανώνει μια σειρά ενημερωτικών εκδηλώσεων στα χωριά που ανήκουν στον Δήμο Βόλου, σχεδιάζει την προσφυγή στη δικαιοσύνη και καλεί τους πολίτες να στηρίξουν τον αγώνα για την προστασία του Νερού και του περιβάλλοντος.


Την Δευτέρα 17/8 πραγματοποιήθηκε ενημερωτική εκδήλωση στον Άγιο Λαυρέντιο (φωτό). Την Δευτέρα 24/8 σειρά έχει η Δράκεια.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: 5 Years After Taliban Takeover, Women & Girls in Afghanistan Have Disappeared from Public Life
content: Restrictions on women’s rights have expanded in Afghanistan since U.S. forces withdrew from the country five years ago, ceding control to the Taliban in the process. Afghan women are banned from attending schools and gyms, books written by women are removed from libraries, doctors and nurses are unable to practice, and child marriage rates have increased. Wives have been rendered legally subordinate to their husbands, and women are required to stay silent in public. “Women and girls of Afghanistan are suffering the most darkest situation in the world,” says Negina Yari, an Afghan women’s rights activist living in exile in Germany, who discusses the impacts of what some advocacy groups are characterizing as “gender apartheid,” as well as the effects of regional diplomatic normalization on the Taliban’s political influence.

title: Yasa derket, niha jî ezmûna aştiyê dest pê dike
content:
Ji Şandeya Îmraliyê ya Partiya Wekhevî û Demokrasiyê ya Gelan (DEM Parti) Pervin Buldan û Faik Ozgur Erol re û ji Sekreteriya Îmraliyê Veysî Aktaş, duh (19ê Tebaxê) di hevdîtineke li otêleke Stenbolê de nêzîkî du saet û nîvan pirsên rojnamevanan bersivandin.


Tê plankirin ku beşa duyem a vê civînê  di rojên pêş de li Enqereyê bê kirin. Civîn mijarên weke  Rojava, vegerên endamên PKKê, qeyum, veguherîna DEM Partiyê û gelekên din li xwe digir.


Şandeya DEM Partiyê tekildarî civîna bi Serokkomar Erdogan re daxuyanî da


14 Tebax 2026


Sernavên sereke yên ku di civînê de derketin pêş ev bûn:


DEM Partiyê, metna yasaya çarçoveyê tenê sibeha ew roja ku wê derkeve dît. Di xuleka dawî de ji bo hin guherînan bi hiqûqnasên AKPê re hevdîtin hatin kirin.


Tê çaverêkirin ku Abdullah Ocalan di pêvajoya ji niha û şûnde de, bi taybetî di organîzasyona çekdanîn û vegerînan de rasterast di komîsyonê de rol bistîne.


Di rojêvê de ye ku Îmralî ji bo rojnameger, akademîsyen, civaka sivîl û rêxistinên jinan were vekirin.


Ji bo ku Mazlum Abdi û İlham Ahmed bi Ocalan re hevdîtinê bikin dixwaz ji herdu aliyan jî heye, lêbelê ji bo serdanê bernameyekî diyarkirî nîne


Kongreya DEM Partiyê ya 6ê Îlonê "kongreya veguherîna esasî" nîne. Tê çaverêkirin ku guherîna berfirehtir berî an piştî Newroza 2027an bê rojevê.


Li ser Selahattin Demirtaş, Figen Yuksekdag û qeyûman ti sozek ji aliyê Erdogan ve nehatiye dayîn. Ya ku heyeta DEM Partiyê ragihandiye, çavdêriyeke ku bi pêşveçûna pêvajoyê re ev mijar jî dikarin bibin rojev.


Li dawiya van hemûyan jî pirsa esasî naguhere:

Gelo Tirkiye dê tenê bi bidawîanîna pevçûnê re sînordar bimîne, an dê bikare bêdengbûna çekan veguhêze aştiyeke mayînde?


Yasa derket, niha dê çi bibe?


Pêvajoya ku ev demeke bi nîqaşên “gelo yasa dê berê derkeve an çekdanîn dê berê bi dawî bibe?” dihat meşandin, derbasî qonaxeke nû bû. Ji niha û şûnde mesele ew e ku dê qanûn çawa bê cîbicîkirin û ka dê çekdanîn veguhere çareseriyeke siyasî ya mayînde an na.


Faik Ozgur Erol yasa wekî “vekirina deriyekî” bi nav kir. Li gorî Erol, pîvan û kapasîteya yasayê heye ku bandorê li ser berdana nêzîkî 4 hezar girtiyên siyasî yên di girtîgehan de û li derve jî li ser zêdetirî 75 hezar dosyeyên lêpirsîn û darizandinê bike. Rewşa nêzîkî 900 kesên ku ji derveyî çarçoveya yasayê hatine hiştin jî dikare di pêvajoya pêş de li ser daxwaz û rayeya desteyê ji nû ve bê rojevê.


Li gorî Veysi Aktaş jî “hîmê hiqûqî ya rêya ber bi aştîya pozîtîf ve diçe” hat danîn. Pervin Buldanê jî got ku medya meseleyê dîsa bi piranî di bin sernavê “teror”ê de digire dest, lê ji niha û şûnde divê ev yek wekî “meseleya aştiyê” bê nirxandin.


Bûldanê ragihand ku Ocalan ji peyv û têgehan zêdetir girîngiyê dide derketina yasayê û vê rêziknameyê wekî “gavê yekem”, “yasaya kîlîlê” û “yasaya kok” dibîne.


Ji ber vê yekê, pirsa ji niha û şûnde ji yasayê zêdetir ew e ku dê li ser wê çi bê avakirin.


"Li ser naverok û rêbaza yasayê rexneyên me jî hene. Me ev yek him di qonaxa amadekirinê de him jî piştî amadekirinê gelek caran anî ziman. Bêguman me jî dixwest ku naverokeke pir berfirehtir hebe ku him di pênasîn û naveroka xwe de demokratîkbûna Tirkiyeyê û çareseriya pirsagirêka Kurd bigire dest, him sedem û encaman nîşan bide û him jî di hincet û metna xwe de vê çarçoveyê hilgire. Lêbelê li gorî rastiya heyî ya welat û hin taybetmendiyên pêvajoyê, xala ku em gihiştinê ev e.


—

Faik Ozgur Erol


"Rêveber û hiqûqnasên AKPê, roja beriya derketina yasayê bi hevalên me re hatin cem hev. Lê me metin tenê sibeha roja ku yasa dê derkeve dît. Li wê derê jî dîsa krîz çêbûn. Weke mînak, di nava yasayê de peyva «teror» û «terorist» gelek dihat bikaranîn; çareseriya pirsgirêkê di çarçoveya siyaseteke ewlehiyê de di yasayê de hatibû nîşandan. Em li dijî vê derketin. Me anî ziman ku li şûna peyvên «teror» û «terorist» zêdetir divê em balê bikişînin ser cewhera meseleyê; têkildarî vê yekê hesasiyeta me û ya gelê me heye. Me hewla wê yekê dan ku em çiqas kêm bikin. Dîsa jî di nav yasayê de ew peyv hatin bikaranîn. Me dîyar kir ku em vê rast nabînin. Lê yasa dîsa jî bi vî awayî derket."


—

Pervin Buldan


Rola Öcalan û vekirina deriyê Îmraliyê


Yek ji sernavên herî girîng ên civînê rola Ocalan a ji niha û şûnde bû.


Buldanê diyar kir ku li bendê ne ku Ocalan di mekanîzmaya çekdanîn û siyasîbûnê ya ku tê plankirin bê avakirin de cih bigire; bi taybetî ji bo organîzekirina vegeran û pêvajoyê ev yek pêwîst tê dîtin.
